gist: Audience objects that it would be debilitated and asks what happens in the 8th house.

hindi: एथ हाउस में उच्च का हो जाएगा उल्टा बिल्कुल उल्टा होगा
says: In the 8th house the Moon is exalted (Taurus for a Libra lagna) and the result is the exact opposite of what the 8th usually gives.
cells_derived_method: Taurus is the 8th house for lagna Libra. An exalted Moon in the 8th turns the usual 8th-house loss into gain through in-laws and the spouse's side.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra, Moon exalted in Taurus in the 8th, gains through the spouse's family.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Moon exalted in Taurus in the 6th, strength against enemies.

ambiguity: The 8th house Moon being exalted fits Libra lagna with Taurus in the 8th.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts do not reverse an 8th-house result, though dignity softens it.

hindi: गजब का ससुराल मिलेगा कंगले घर में पैदा होगा ससुराल के दम पर ही रॉकेट बन जाएगा अमीर ससुराल मिलेगा
says: The person gets an excellent in-law family, born in a poor home yet rising like a rocket on the strength of rich in-laws.
cells_derived_method: 8th house is the spouse's wealth, 2nd from the 7th; a strong Moon there gives a rich in-law side.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra, exalted Moon in Taurus in the 8th, wealth and rise via the spouse's family.

ambiguity: The in-law result is tied to the exalted Moon in the 8th only by context.

gist: Garbled line: rich in-laws as per Parashara.

hindi: हां तो यही तो खिचड़ी बनानी है।
says: This is exactly the khichdi (mix) he wants to make: combining the Parashari sign view with the Kalapurusha house view into one reading.

hindi: वह काल पुरुष के हिसाब से भले ही हो वह स्थान है लेकिन उसके बावजूद चंद्रमा उच्च फल देगा।
says: Even if by the Kalapurusha reckoning that place is a weak spot, the Moon still gives exalted results there.
ambiguity: Which place is meant is only clear from the Libra lagna example.

hindi: हां काल पुरुष की कुंडली एक स्टैंडर्ड कुंडली है।
says: The Kalapurusha chart, with Aries as the first house, is a standard chart used as the reference frame.
classical_check: Agrees: Kalapurusha is the natural zodiac chart.

hindi: इसके अंदर लाल किताब का बहुत महत्व आता है।
says: Lal Kitab, which also works on fixed house meanings, is very important in this approach.
classical_check: Lal Kitab is a separate tradition from classical Parashari.

hindi: लेकिन ये आपका एक्सपीरियंस आपको बताएगा।
says: He says only your own experience with charts will tell you how to weigh this.

hindi: आठवां चंद्रमा उच्च का बिल्कुल हो सकता है।
says: The Moon in the 8th house can be exalted, which is the case of Taurus as the 8th house.
cells_derived_method: Taurus is the 8th house only for lagna Libra.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Libra, Moon exalted in Taurus in the 8th.

classical_check: Agrees as a fact about dignity; he gives it a benefic reading.

gist: Says such a state can exist.

hindi: छठा चंद्रमा उच्च का है।
says: The Moon in the 6th house can also be exalted, which happens when Taurus is the 6th house.
cells_derived_method: Taurus is the 6th house for lagna Sagittarius.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Moon exalted in Taurus in the 6th.

classical_check: Agrees as a fact of dignity.

gist: Says it does happen.
Says something interesting is coming.

hindi: हमारे जो महीने जीवन के हैं साल भर के 12 महीने चलते हैं।
says: The twelve months of the year run in life under two different systems, solar and lunar.

hindi: सूर्य देवता की कृपा से जनवरी फरवरी चलता है।
says: The January-February style months follow the Sun, the solar calendar.

hindi: और हमारे चंदा मामा के वजह से चैत वैशाख जेठा।
says: The Chaitra, Vaishakha, Jyeshtha months come from the Moon, the lunar calendar.
classical_check: Agrees: the Hindu months are lunar.

gist: Says a lovely thing follows.

hindi: सूर्य देवता घूमते फिरते नाचते हुए यह शनि की 10 नंबर राशि है।
says: The Sun in its round passes through sign 10 (Capricorn), which is Saturn's sign.

hindi: 11 12 एक दो तीन चार पांच छ सात आठ नौ एक नंबर राशि से हमारा मंगल महाराज का कार्यक्रम शुरू होता है और हमारा महीना शुरू हो जाता है।
says: Counting forward from sign 10 through 11, 12 and then 1 onward, the Sun reaches sign 1 (Aries), Mars's sign, where the Mars programme and the new (Chaitra) month begin.
ambiguity: The count is stated in a run; the Chaitra link is solar approximate.
classical_check: Aries as the first sign is classical; Chaitra start with Aries is approximate.

hindi: इसके अंदर एक दो तीन चार पांच छ ये श्रावण का महीना ये वाला है।
says: Counting months from Chaitra, he lands on Shravan as the sixth, though by strict count Shravan is fifth.
ambiguity: The count of six may be a slip or a different start month.
classical_check: Differs: Shravan is the 5th month from Chaitra.

gist: Garbled counting of Ashadha and Vaishakha.

hindi: महीने हैं चैत वैशाख जेठ आषाढ़ श्रावण भादो आश्विन कार्तिक मंगसर पौष माघ फागगुन
says: He lists the twelve lunar months in order from Chaitra to Phalguna as the frame for tying the Moon calendar to the signs.

hindi: इस टाइम के अंदर 10 तारीख 10 नवंबर के अंदर सूर्य देवता मकर सक्रांति मनाने आते हैं।
says: Around the 10th to 14th the Sun arrives to celebrate Makar Sankranti; the caption says 10 November but January is meant.
ambiguity: The month slip: Sankranti is mid-January.
classical_check: Sankranti is about 14 January; the date is loose.

hindi: मकर सक्रांति मकर राशि में प्रवेश करते हैं।
says: On Makar Sankranti the Sun enters Capricorn.

hindi: अब यह शनि का पोर्टल है।
says: Capricorn is Saturn's gateway, the portal of the dark planet.

hindi: बिल्कुल अंधकार है।
says: The Capricorn zone is complete darkness in his symbolism, the lowest point of light.

hindi: सारे के सारे राक्षस इसके नीचे शुरू होते हैं जो राक्षस देवता माने जाते हैं।
says: All the demons are said to begin below this point, the same ones regarded as gods, so the dark half of the sky is demon territory.
ambiguity: The meaning is loose.

hindi: यह सूर्य देवता जब यहां आ गए नीचे की ओर गिर रहे थे तो इन्होंने तो अंधेरे में भी उजाला कर दिया यार।
says: The Sun, falling downward until it reached Capricorn, lit up even this darkness, so Capricorn is where it turns upward.
classical_check: Agrees with the winter solstice symbolism.

hindi: जब पौष का महीना होता है तो उसमें कहते हैं शादी नहीं करनी।
says: In the month of Paush, people say do not hold a marriage.
ambiguity: Paush is when the Sun is in Sagittarius (Dhanu) mainly.
classical_check: Agrees: Kharmas (Dhanu month) is avoided for marriage.

hindi: पो के महीने में पितरों के लिए महीना रिजर्व कर दिया।
says: The common explanation is that Paush is reserved for the ancestors, so nothing auspicious is done.

hindi: ऐसा कुछ नहीं है।
says: He rejects the ancestor explanation, saying that is not the real reason.

hindi: एक्चुअली क्या होता है कि पौष का महीना जैसे 15 तारीख शुरू हुआ।
says: His real reason: Paush starts around the 15th, after the Sun enters Sagittarius.

hindi: संक्रांति आई दिसंबर में 15 दिसंबर से 15 जनवरी ऐसे ही ले रहे हैं हम फिक्स फिगर
says: The Sankranti falls in December, and he takes 15 December to 15 January as the fixed span of the Sun's Sagittarius month.

hindi: तो उस टाइम में सूरज धरती के एक्चुअली बहुत पास होता है
says: In that window the Sun is actually very close to the Earth, which he uses as the cause of the Paush restrictions.
ambiguity: A physical claim; Earth is nearest to the Sun in early January.

hindi: वो इतना पास होता है कि अगर उस टाइम में धरती में कोई बीज डाला जाए तो नीचे जर्मिनेशन बीज के द्वारा जो पेड़ बने वो ढंका बनने के बजाय वो सूरज उसको खींच लेता है बाहर
says: So close that a seed sown then would be pulled out by the Sun instead of growing a proper tree under the ground; a folk argument, not a measured claim.

hindi: तो ऐसी स्थिति में बीज प्रॉपर फ्रूट नहीं दे पाता
says: In that situation the seed cannot give proper fruit.

hindi: 40 50 साल के लिए जो पेड़ बनेगा वो बन नहीं पाता ढंग का क्योंकि वो खींचा है उसके बीज को धरती ने धरती के बाहर खींच लिया है
says: A tree meant to live 40 to 50 years does not form properly because the seed is drawn out of the ground.
ambiguity: The sentence ends in the next chunk.

hindi: तो शुक्र शुक्र भी प्रभावित हो गया।
says: Venus, the planet of seed and fertility, is also affected in that month.
classical_check: Venus as semen and fertility is classical.

hindi: तो सूर्य देवता के उस एक महीने के दौरान वो कहते हैं यार ये महीना ठीक नहीं है यार।
says: During that one month of the Sun in this position people say it is an unfavourable month.

hindi: इसमें ना कुछ करना ही नहीं है।
says: Nothing new should be started in that month.

hindi: ये तो पितरों का टाइम है भाई।
says: The reason people give is that this is the time of the ancestors.

hindi: इसमें तो पूजा पाठ भगवान शादी नहीं करनी।
says: In this month do worship and prayer, but no marriage.

hindi: शादी करेंगे पति पत्नी के बीच हो सकता है सेक्स के लिए द्वारा संतान गर्भ में आ जाए।
says: If a marriage is held then, a child may be conceived between the couple in that very month.

hindi: अब आ जाए तो रिस्क उसका ये है कि वो बच्चा पूर्ण रूप से पनप नहीं पाएगा।
says: The risk is that a child conceived in this month will not develop fully; a folk claim, not medical advice.

hindi: प्रॉपर जन्म नहीं ले पाएगा।
says: Such a child will not take a proper birth, again a folk claim and not a medical statement.

hindi: उसके आंतरिक ग्रोथ नहीं होगी।
says: The child's inner growth will not take place, the third form of the same folk warning.

hindi: क्योंकि बीज अंडाणु और वीर्याणु दोनों ढंग से उनके अंदर की जो ऊर्जा मिल नहीं पाएगी।
says: His reason: the egg and the sperm cannot get the energy within them in the proper way because of the Sun's pull.

hindi: सूर्य उसको खींच लेगा।
says: The Sun will draw that energy away, which is the core of his seed-pulling argument.

hindi: अब जैसे ही ये 10 नंबर में आया प्रकाशमान हुआ।
says: As soon as the Sun enters sign 10 (Capricorn) it becomes luminous and starts to give light.

hindi: अब ऊपर की ओर चलने की तैयारी कर दी।
says: Now the Sun is getting ready to move upward, northward.

gist: Says people then announce that Makar Sankranti has come.

hindi: पूजा पाठ करो।
says: At Makar Sankranti do worship, which is an auspicious time for puja.

hindi: सूरज जब उत्तर आयन उत्तरायण दक्षिण आयन उत्तर की ओर जाना शुरू करेगा।
says: Uttarayan is when the Sun starts moving toward the north, opposite to dakshinayan, the southward course.

gist: Bhishma Pitamah waited to die at Uttarayan so he would go upward to heaven.
Rhetorical question: what did the Sun do by coming here?
Says it took a month, a fragmentary answer.

hindi: इस महीने के ऑनवर्ड्स सबसे पहले तो उत्सव कर दिया।
says: From this month onward the first thing done is a festival, so a celebration marks the Sun's turning point.

hindi: मकर सक्रांति का हिसाब बना दिया।
says: The Makar Sankranti reckoning was set, meaning the festival date was fixed on the solar entry into Capricorn.

hindi: फिर मकर माघ महीने में आ गया।
says: Then Makar Sankranti falls in the month of Magh.
classical_check: Agrees: it falls in Paush end and Magh start.

hindi: ये पौष का महीना पौष माघ फागगुन चैत चैत का महीना आधा इसमें है।
says: Going on, Paush, Magh, Phalguna and then Chaitra come in order, with half of Chaitra overlapping this stretch.

gist: Half of Chaitra is in this part.

hindi: दोनों में पड़ता है ये।
says: Chaitra falls partly in both halves, because the lunar month does not line up with the solar one.
classical_check: Agrees that lunar and solar months overlap.

hindi: तो ये हो गई हमारी मान लो 15 जनवरी।
says: Take this point as roughly 15 January on the solar calendar, for the sake of a rough map.

gist: Asks the audience whether that is ok.

hindi: ये 15 फरवरी, 15 मार्च, 15 अप्रैल।
says: The month markers continue as 15 February, 15 March and 15 April, rough dates for the Sun's passage through successive signs.
classical_check: Sankrantis fall about the 14th and 15th of each month.

hindi: ये हमारा 15 अप्रैल का टाइम आ गया मोटा-मोटा।
says: Roughly 15 April is when the Sun enters Aries, the start of sign 1.
classical_check: Agrees: Mesha Sankranti is about 14 April.

hindi: अब एक नंबर का आ गया यह एक नंबर यह हो गया हमारा चैत का शुक्ल पक्ष
says: With sign 1 (Aries) the bright half of Chaitra begins, the first fortnight of his year.
ambiguity: Lunar Chaitra shukla starts about a month earlier than Mesha Sankranti; he is approximating.
classical_check: Differs slightly in dates, agrees on Chaitra start.

gist: Points to the dark half and bright half on the board.

hindi: शुक्ल पक्ष मींस चंदा मामा चांद कह रहा है उठो बढ़ो ऊपर की ओर जाना है
says: The bright half means the Moon is telling you to rise and grow upward.

hindi: चांद ने पावर पकड़ ली
says: The Moon has picked up power in the bright half.

hindi: सूर्य हमारा पिता है चंद्रमा हमारा पानी शरीर का आत्मा के साथ पानी मिला उठा नवीनता
says: The Sun is our father and the Moon the water of the body; when the soul joins the water, newness rises.
classical_check: Agrees on Sun as father and soul, Moon as water.

hindi: एक नंबर मंगल महाराज नाभि पे आ गए
says: Sign 1 with Mars sits at the navel, the body part he links to Aries and Mars in his scheme.
ambiguity: Aries is usually the head in Kalapurusha; the navel is his own placement.
classical_check: Differs: Kalapurusha gives Aries the head, not the navel.

hindi: नाभि ही हमें शरीर को बना के देती है पूरा
says: The navel is what builds the entire body, which is why he gives it to the first sign and Mars.

hindi: इसके अंदर एक नंबर में चैत आते ही सबसे पहले हमारे नवरात्र का फंक्शन हो गया।
says: As soon as Chaitra arrives with sign 1, the Navratri festival comes first.
classical_check: Agrees: Chaitra Navratri opens the year.

hindi: नवरात्र के समय में क्या चीज बनी कि नवरात्रों में हमें पूजा करनी है।
says: The custom that arose is that during Navratri we must worship, as the start of the year.
ambiguity: The sentence runs into the next chunk.

hindi: माता की पूजा करी देवी की।
says: The worship is of the Mother Goddess.

gist: Rhetorical question: which goddess?

hindi: चंद्रमा स्त्री रूप है।
says: The Moon is the feminine form, so the goddess in this context is the Moon.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon is a feminine planet.

hindi: देवी के रूप में करने मात्र से हमारा प्रथम स्टार्ट।
says: Just by worshipping in the goddess form we get our first start of the year.

hindi: तो चंदा मामा का आवाहन किया जाता है।
says: So in effect the Moon is invoked at Navratri.

hindi: शुरुआत की जाती है यहां से।
says: The year's beginning is made from here, with the lunar worship.

gist: Rhetorical question: what do people do in Navratri?

hindi: व्रत करो।
says: Keep a fast during Navratri, the main observance.

gist: Rhetorical question: what does a fast mean?

hindi: पेट में आपको पानी नहीं डालना।
says: A fast, in his definition, means not putting water into the stomach, that is keeping watery food out.
ambiguity: This is not the usual meaning of vrat.
classical_check: Differs from the usual meaning of fasting.

hindi: पानी के द्वारा होता है भोजन।
says: Food is made digestible through water, so food and water are linked.

hindi: अन्न जो है उसमें पानी ज्यादा लगता है।
says: Grains take a lot of water to cook, so grain food adds much water to the body.

hindi: जैसे चावल है, आटा इसमें बहुत पानी लगता है।
says: Rice and wheat flour are the examples that need a lot of water, so they are avoided in the fast.
classical_check: Agrees with the fast rule of avoiding rice and wheat.

hindi: अब कुट्टू वगैरह जो है इसमें पानी बहुत कम लगता है।
says: Buckwheat and similar fasting grains need very little water, which is why they are allowed.

hindi: कोदरा जो है जरा से पानी से हो जाता है।
says: Kodra millet cooks with only a little water, another allowed fasting grain.

hindi: तो पानी को कम शरीर में जाने देना है ताकि चंद्रमा की वाइब्रेशन कम से कम आए।
says: The aim is to let less water into the body so that the Moon's vibration is at a minimum during the fast.

hindi: चंद्रमा की वाइब्रेशन पावर पकड़ने मात्र से आपका डिटॉक्सिफाई हो रही है बॉडी।
says: Merely by the Moon's vibration gaining power, the body is detoxified; he treats this as a health benefit and not a medical fact.

hindi: इसलिए स्त्रियों को विशेष तौर पे कहते हैं क्योंकि स्त्री तत्व है।
says: This is why women are especially told to fast, because the woman is the feminine principle.

hindi: स्त्री ही ग्रह है चंद्रमा।
says: The Moon is the female planet itself.

hindi: इसलिए डिटॉक्सिफाई होना है।
says: The purpose of the whole practice is detoxification of the body.

hindi: सबसे पहले आपको नवरात्रों में व्रत रखो।
says: The first thing to do in Navratri is to keep the fast.

hindi: अच्छा चलो एक दिन का रख लो कोई बात नहीं।
says: Even a fast of a single day is acceptable if the full period is not possible.

hindi: फिर सबको भोजन कराओ।
says: Then feed everyone, giving food as the follow-up remedy.

gist: Rhetorical question: whom to feed? Answer comes next.

hindi: कंजक।
says: The answer to whom to feed in Navratri is kanjak, the young girls fed as the goddess's form.
ambiguity: A one-word answer to the previous question.
classical_check: Silent; Kanya Pujan is a custom.

gist: Rhetorical question: who is kanjak?

hindi: कन्या।
says: A kanjak is a kanya, a young unmarried girl.

gist: Rhetorical question: who is the kanya?

hindi: बुद्ध।
says: The young girl is Mercury (Budh) in his planet scheme.
classical_check: Agrees with Mercury as a young girl.

hindi: छोटी बुद्ध की पूजा हो रही है।

hindi: अब एक बच्चा पैदा हो गया उसकी तुला राशि है जन्म के समय।
says: Example: a child is born with the Moon in Libra (sign 7) at birth.

hindi: तो र अक्षर से जैसे नाम रखा जाना चाहिए इसका।
says: That child's name should begin with the syllable ra, as Libra uses the ra and ta set of syllables.
classical_check: Agrees: Libra syllables include ra, ri, ru, re, ro, ta, ti, tu, te.

gist: Says this is how it goes.
Sets up another child being born.

hindi: इसकी कन्या राशि है।
says: This second child has the Moon in Virgo (sign 6) at birth.

gist: Says the Moon was here at the time of birth.
The parents went to the pandit.
Asks the pandit to name the child and what will happen.

hindi: जी ये तो बच्चा कन्या राशि का प अक्षर से नाम रख दीजिए।
says: The pandit says the child is of the Virgo rashi, so give a name starting with pa.
classical_check: Agrees: Virgo syllables include pa, pi, pu, pe, po.

gist: The parents agree it is the birth rashi.

hindi: इसी से रखते हैं।
says: The name is kept from that birth rashi's syllables, as is the usual practice.

hindi: लेकिन पंडित जी ने छठा घर एक्टिवेट कर दिया है।
says: But by giving a Virgo-set name the pandit has activated the 6th house, since Virgo is sign 6 and the 6th house in the natural chart.
cells_derived_method: The name activates the sign Virgo; Virgo as the 6th house is a Aries-lagna chart, and in other charts it activates whichever house Virgo occupies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Virgo as the 6th house activated, the house of enemies, debt and disease.
Derived: lagna Virgo, the name activates the 1st house, self and body.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, the name activates the 10th house, career.

ambiguity: Which houses are affected depends on the chart; he points only to the natural 6th.
classical_check: Differs from classical naming rules; the activation claim is his own.

hindi: यह बच्चा महासडियल रहेगा।
says: The child will remain very dull and slow-witted, a trait claim from the 6th-house activation.
ambiguity: A sweeping trait claim.

hindi: लिखने में नंबर नहीं आएंगे।
says: The child will not score marks in written work, again from the 6th-house activation; a tradition claim, not a prediction for any one child.

hindi: चंद्रमा एक्सप्रेशन है।
says: Moon is the significator of expression, meaning how a person gets feelings and thoughts out in speech and writing.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Moon rules mind and feeling, Mercury is the usual speech and writing karaka.

hindi: चंद्रमा दूषित है तो हिंदी या इंग्लिश एक की राइटिंग खराब होगी बच्चे की।
says: If the Moon is afflicted in a child's chart, the child's handwriting in Hindi or in English (one of the two) will be poor.
cells_derived_method: Strength of the affliction depends on where the Moon sits: house 6, 8, 12 or debilitation in Scorpio makes the damage stronger, while a well placed Moon with no malefic link gives little effect.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: debilitated Moon in a dusthana, a strong candidate for the poor handwriting and weak expression he describes.
Derived, not said by him: exalted Moon in the 1st, so the fault would need a separate conjunction or aspect to show.

ambiguity: 'Afflicted' (dushit) is not defined here: conjunction, aspect, house or sign.
classical_check: Classical texts are silent on handwriting; this is his own extension.

hindi: चंद्रमा दूषित होना चाहिए।
says: Condition for the handwriting rule: it only applies when the Moon is genuinely afflicted, not for every chart.
ambiguity: No test for what counts as afflicted is given.

hindi: 100% उसकी हिंदी इंग्लिश एक की राइटिंग खराब होगी।
says: He claims certainty (100 percent) that one of the two scripts will have bad handwriting when the Moon is afflicted; this is an unmeasured strong claim.
classical_check: No classical text gives such certainty; treat the 100 percent as his emphasis, not a measured figure.

hindi: एक्सप्रेशन डाउन होगा उसका।
says: The general ability of that child to express himself will be lowered.

hindi: कुछ ना कुछ टुकड़ुपड़ू बोलेगा वो।
says: Speech of such a child will come out in broken, fragmentary bits, saying some half-formed thing or other.
ambiguity: Colloquial phrase tukdu-pukdu; exact kind of speech fault is unclear (not a speech disorder diagnosis).

hindi: चंद्रमा के दोष होने मात्र से अडियल सडियल कुड़ियल ये यहां बैठेगा ही बैठेगा।
says: A Moon fault alone is enough to make the child stubborn, sour and sulky in temperament; he says the trait will certainly settle in.
cells_derived_method: Temperament changes by sign nature: Moon afflicted in a fixed sign reads as stubborn, in a fire sign as irritable, in a water sign as moody.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: debilitated Moon in a fixed water sign gives deep sulking and holding on to hurt.
Derived, not said by him: Moon in a fire cardinal sign shows the stubbornness as open temper and public defiance.

ambiguity: 'Yahan' (here) points at a spot on the board; unclear.
classical_check: Moon affliction giving moodiness is classical; the strong word certainly is his.

hindi: अब ये चंद्रमा की जन्म की राशि रखी हो यहां हालांकि लेकिन आपने एक्टिवेट दूसरी करी।
says: Sets up a case: the birth Moon sign sits at one spot on his drawn chart, but the parents activated a different sign through the first letter of the name.
ambiguity: Which sign the Moon was drawn in is not audible in the caption.
classical_check: Name-letter (nakshatra pada) giving the naam rashi is classical, but a separate activated sign is his usage.

gist: Rhetorical question: what name should now be given to this child?

hindi: इसका नाम बदलो।
says: Corrective measure: change the child's name so that the activated sign moves to a better position relative to the Moon.
classical_check: Renaming as a remedy is not a classical Parashari rule.

hindi: इसका नाम चार नंबर राशि से रखो।
says: In his drawn example he first allows choosing the name from the sign marked number 4.
ambiguity: Number 4 may be sign number (Cancer) of the example or a count from the Moon; and a few lines later he says the 4th should be avoided, so he contradicts himself.
classical_check: No classical text for this naming-position rule.

says: Number 10 is also acceptable as the sign from which to take the name letter in that example.
ambiguity: Same sign-number versus count-from-Moon doubt as the previous line.

hindi: इसका नाम दो नंबर राशि से रखो।
says: Number 2 (second position or Taurus) is allowed for the name letter.
ambiguity: Whether this is the 2nd sign from Moon or sign Taurus is unclear.

hindi: तीन से रखो, सात से रखो।
says: Numbers 3 and 7 are also allowed as the naming position in this example; the 3rd is contradicted a few lines later.
ambiguity: Later he forbids the 3rd; the two lists cannot both be counts from the same base.

hindi: यहां से चंद्रमा दूसरा है रख सकते हैं।
says: If the name sign falls second from the birth Moon sign it can be kept.
ambiguity: Seems to be a count from Moon sign; sign not given.
classical_check: Silent; classical Rashi koota only marks 2/12, 6/8 and 5/9 pairs.

hindi: तीसरा नौ आठ नंबर य से नहीं रखना।
says: Do not take the name from the third position, and (garbled numbers 9 and 8) not from the sign with the letter Ya, which is Scorpio.
ambiguity: Caption garbled around 'nau aath'; Ya belongs to Scorpio (8) in the usual letter table.

hindi: चौथा अवॉइड करो।
says: Avoid the fourth position for the name sign.
ambiguity: Contradicts the earlier 'name from number 4' line.

hindi: चौथी राशि नहीं होनी चाहिए।
says: States as a firm prohibition that the name sign must not be the 4th sign from the Moon sign.
ambiguity: Which base the 4th is counted from is not stated, assumed the Moon sign.

gist: Remark that this is a technical matter.

hindi: भ और ध से रख सकते हैं।
says: Names beginning with Bha or Dha (letters of Sagittarius) are acceptable in this position.
ambiguity: Which position in the example this letter pair belongs to is unclear.
classical_check: Letter to sign table is classical (Bha, Dha, Pha, Dha belong to Sagittarius).

hindi: यहां हालांकि ये पांचवा है।
says: Moves to the next example position: this one lies fifth from the Moon.
ambiguity: Judgement of the 5th comes in the next lines.

gist: Repeats the single word fifth.

hindi: यहां एक्टिवेट करो।
says: The fifth position is a good one to activate through the name sign.
ambiguity: Referent of 'here' assumed to be the 5th.
classical_check: 5th from Moon is a trine, classically friendly.

hindi: चंद्रमा इसका इसका ज से नाम रख लो।
says: Gives the letter Ja as the name initial for this fifth-position case.
ambiguity: Ja is not clearly tied to one sign in the usual letter table; sign unknown.

hindi: यहां एस से रख सकते हैं।
says: In the next position the letter S can be used for the name.
ambiguity: Which position and sign S belongs to is unclear; caption may be garbled.

hindi: अवॉयड करो रखना।
says: Avoid keeping the name in the position he is pointing to next.
ambiguity: Position not named in this sentence; it is the sixth per the next line.

hindi: चंद्रमा छठा है अपने जन्म राशि से।
says: Names the sixth place counted from the birth Moon sign as the position under judgement.
ambiguity: Sentence runs into the next caption block.
classical_check: 6th from Moon is the enemy position, classically avoided in Rashi koota.

hindi: अवॉयड फिर भी होगा तो रख लें क्योंकि ज्यादा बुरा है।
says: The sixth is to be avoided, but if no other choice exists it can be accepted, because the alternative he is comparing it with is even worse.
ambiguity: Caption garbled: which option is 'more bad' is not clear.

hindi: द से रख लिया नुकसान करेगा।
says: If the child is named with the letter Da in this position it will cause harm.
ambiguity: Da belongs to Pisces in the letter table, but which position is meant is unclear.

hindi: नहीं होना चाहिए।
says: Concludes that a name chosen this way should not be done at all.
ambiguity: Refers to the previous line's Da naming.

hindi: यहां पर भी सातवा आठवां हो गया।
says: The seventh and eighth positions from the Moon sign are also placed in the bad group for naming.
ambiguity: He says 'ho gaya' without giving the verdict; read as avoid because the speech is in a list of avoid items.
classical_check: 8th from Moon is classically bad in Rashi koota, 7th is neutral to mixed.

hindi: तो अगर इसकी जन्म की राशि ए अ से रख दी ए से अमिताभ बच्चन वाला अमर अमित रख दिया।
says: If the name is taken from the same sign as the birth Moon sign (here the A and E letters, as in Amar or Amit), that same-sign naming is the case he is calling bad.
ambiguity: Mentioning Amitabh Bachchan is only for the sound of the letter; he draws no conclusion about that person here.
classical_check: Silent; classical practice usually names from the birth nakshatra pada, which is the Moon sign itself.

hindi: नेगेटिव है।
says: Verdict: naming from the birth sign letters is negative.
classical_check: Differs from classical custom of naming by the janma rashi letters.

gist: Says 'not good', repeating the previous verdict.
A listener asks if he can write one, two, three, four in the side chart.
Listener asks what a rashi name is.
Listener asks which letter belongs to a rashi.

hindi: चर राशि लिए फिर स्थिर लिए द्वभाव लिए अलग ले लिए।
says: Answering the listener, he groups the signs by their nature: movable, fixed and dual signs are taken one group at a time when the letters are assigned.
ambiguity: Garbled caption; exact meaning of 'alag le lie' is not clear.
classical_check: Movable/fixed/dual classification is standard; its use for letters is not.

hindi: ये राशियां है इसमें।
says: Says these are the signs involved in the table he is showing.
ambiguity: Refers to something on the board; little content.

gist: Rhetorical question: which sign did you activate it from?

hindi: जन्म नाम से राशि रखना हाइली नेगेटिव अगर कुंडली अच्छी नहीं है।
says: Giving the child a name from the birth-Moon-sign letters is highly negative whenever the horoscope itself is not good; in a good chart it may be fine.
ambiguity: No test given for a good or bad kundali.
classical_check: Differs from the common practice of naming by the birth sign letters.

hindi: मान लेते हैं किसी बालक की कुंडली में यह स्थिति बनी है कि इसका भाग्य स्थान में दो नंबर राशि है।
says: Example: in a boy's chart the 9th house (house of fortune) carries sign number 2, Taurus.
cells_derived_method: Taurus (2) on the 9th means lagna = 2-9+1 = -6, +12 = 6, Virgo. The fortune house is then colored by Taurus and its lord Venus.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna works out to Virgo, so fortune house is tied to Taurus and its lord Venus.

ambiguity: 'Do number rashi' might be sign 2 or 2nd counted otherwise; taken as Taurus.

hindi: तो हम क्यों ना बढ़िया नाम रखें।
says: Reasoning: since the fortune house is known, why not choose the best naming sign for the child from it.
cells_derived_method: The best naming sign is the sign on the 9th, so it varies with the sign sitting in the 9th house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with Leo on the 9th he says the 9th is not worth activating (see later lines).

hindi: इसका व इसे रखो।
says: With Taurus on the 9th house, take the name from the Taurus letters, Va and similar sounds.
cells_derived_method: Same step for another 9th sign: use that sign's letters.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: take Ha or Da letters, as he says in the next line.

ambiguity: Caption 'व इसे' is partly garbled.
classical_check: Va, Vi, Vu, Ve, Vo are Taurus letters in the classical table.

hindi: देखो भाग्य स्थान उठाओ।
says: Method: take up the 9th house, that is, read the sign sitting on the fortune house and use its name letters.

gist: Exclamation: how wonderful that is.

hindi: चार नंबर राशि है।
says: Second example: sign 4, Cancer, sits on the 9th house.
ambiguity: House 9 is assumed from the previous lines.

hindi: इसका ड से
says: Start of the letter list for Cancer on the 9th: the letter Da is one of the choices.
ambiguity: Sentence cut by the caption break; completes in the next block.
classical_check: Da belongs to Cancer in the letter table.

hindi: रखो। ह से रखो।
says: For Cancer on the 9th, the name can also start with Ha.
classical_check: Ha is a Cancer letter classically.

hindi: पांच नंबर राशि है।
says: Third example: sign 5, Leo, is on the 9th house.

hindi: भाग्य स्थान उठाने का कोई फायदा नहीं।
says: When Leo is on the 9th there is no benefit in activating the fortune house through the name sign.
ambiguity: Why Leo is poor here is not explained.
classical_check: Silent; Leo on the 9th is classically ok.

hindi: चंद्रमा की राशि यहां डाल दोगे।
says: If you drop the Moon-sign name letters into that spot (the Leo 9th), the effect is poor.
ambiguity: Unclear what 'put here' means; assumed putting the Moon sign name there.

hindi: म अक्षर से ट अक्षर से नेगेटिव सिंह राशि में चार नंबर पांच चंद्रमा को एक्टिवेट करना नॉट गुड
says: Names beginning with Ma or Ta (Leo letters) are negative here, and activating the Moon in Leo with the 4 and 5 counts is not good.
ambiguity: The numbers 4 and 5 are unclear: could be house, sign or count.

hindi: तो ये आपको अलग देखना है कि किस राशि के साथ आप कैसे करेंगे ये गलत नहीं होना चाहिए
says: You must judge each case separately, deciding for each sign how to name so the result does not go wrong.

hindi: यहां पर आपने छह नंबर राशि है बच्चा पैदा हुआ प अक्षर से नाम रख दिया ये इसके लिए नेगेटिव करेगा
says: If the child is born with Moon in sign 6 (Virgo) and is named with Pa (a Virgo letter), the same-sign name works negatively.
ambiguity: Reading assumes the 6 is the Moon sign.

hindi: आठ नंबर राशि है जन्म राशि रख दी नरेंद्र मोदी वाली य यतिन वाली ये इसका सत्यानाश कर देगा जिंदगी भर के लिए बीमार कर देगा
says: With birth sign 8 (Scorpio) and a Scorpio-letter name like Narendra or Yatin, he says this ruins the person and keeps him ill for life. Treat the health claim as his tradition claim, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Names of public figures are used only as sound examples.
classical_check: Silent; the lifelong illness claim has no classical backing.

hindi: लड़की है उसका का छठे घर का चंद्रमा है।
says: Example: a girl whose Moon is in the 6th house.
cells_derived_method: Moon in the 6th lies in a different sign for each lagna, so the same naming rule gives different results by sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in Capricorn on the 6th gives lagna Leo (10-6+1=5); Moon sits in Saturn's sign (a cold, duty-bound Moon), and Scorpio name letters would fall on the 4th sign from lagna.
Derived, not said by him: Moon in own sign on the 6th gives lagna Aquarius (4-6+1=-1, 11), softer for a same-sign name.

classical_check: Moon in the 6th is a dusthana placement, usually weak.

hindi: इसका नाम मान लेते हैं नेगेटिव है।
says: Assume her name-sign is a negative one.

hindi: या अक्षर से नाम है।
says: Her name begins with the letter Ya, a Scorpio letter.
classical_check: Ya is a Scorpio letter in the usual table.

hindi: आठ नंबर राशि है।
says: Confirms that the name sign is number 8, Scorpio.

hindi: हाईली नेगेटिव।
says: Verdict for Moon in the 6th with a Scorpio-letter name: highly negative.

hindi: महा लड़ाकी महा बहस्पति से लड़ाई झगड़े होते ही रहेंगे सारे टाइम।
says: She will become a great fighter and a great arguer, with quarrels all the time.
ambiguity: Word 'bahaspati' read as 'bahas' (argument).
classical_check: Moon in the 6th with Scorpio energy plausibly gives conflict; no classical text on name letters.

hindi: सत्यानाश हो।
says: Exclaims that the result will be a complete wreck of her life.
ambiguity: Emphatic curse-like wording, no specific event.

hindi: सातवां घर वीक हो तो तलाक।
says: If the 7th house is also weak, the result for her marriage is divorce.
cells_derived_method: Weakness of the 7th depends on its sign: a debilitated or afflicted lord sign (for example Aries or Scorpio on the 7th with Mars troubled) makes the divorce reading stronger.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars-ruled 7th is prone to conflict in marriage.
Derived, not said by him: Venus-ruled 7th is stable unless Venus is afflicted.

ambiguity: 'Weak' not defined.
classical_check: Weak or afflicted 7th causing marital breakdown is classical, divorce certainty is not.

gist: Rhetorical question: what should be done at the time of her marriage?

hindi: नाम राशि बदल दो।
says: Remedy at the time of marriage: change the name sign (the naam rashi).
classical_check: Not found in the classical remedy texts.

hindi: इसका नाम चार नंबर से रख लो।
says: For the new name, choose sign 4 (Cancer) letters.
ambiguity: Sign number versus position count again.

hindi: ह से रख लो।
says: Pick the letter Ha as the new name initial (Cancer).

hindi: राशि बदल दो।
says: If the first option does not suit, change the name sign again, trying a different sign.

hindi: प से रख लो।
says: Another option offered: use the letter Pa (a Virgo letter) for the new name.
ambiguity: Pa is Virgo here; it was called negative for a Virgo Moon earlier, so it is only fine for other Moon signs.

hindi: राशि बदल दो।
says: Keep changing the sign until a suitable one is found; the list goes on to sign 12.
ambiguity: Same words as an earlier line, but they close this particular list.

hindi: ज द से रख लो।
says: Another option: names starting with Ja or Da (Pisces letters) for the new name.
ambiguity: Ja is not strictly a Pisces letter; Da is.
classical_check: Da is a Pisces letter; Ja is uncertain.

hindi: 12 नंबर आ गया।
says: Notes that this option is the 12th sign, Pisces.

hindi: राशि बदल लो।
says: The point of the list: switch the name sign so it moves off the damaging position.

hindi: यह बदलने से इसके
says: Start of the claim that changing the name sign will alter her nature.
ambiguity: Sentence breaks across the caption block, completed in the next row.

hindi: स्वभाव में परिवर्तन ही आ जाएगा ऑटोमेटिकली।
says: Changing the name sign brings a change in her temperament by itself, without any other action.
ambiguity: Completes the sentence from the previous caption block.
classical_check: No classical backing for temperament change by renaming.

hindi: इसलिए आप जन्म के नाम पर जो राशि रख रहे हैं, वह आपके लिए नेगेटिव है।
says: Conclusion: the rashi taken from the name given at birth is negative for the person, so the birth-name sign should not be relied on.
ambiguity: Earlier he limited this to bad charts; here he states it broadly.
classical_check: Differs from classical naming by birth nakshatra pada.

gist: Says an interesting point about numerology will be taken up in a later class.

hindi: यहां पर आठ नंबर है।
says: Numerology illustration: the number 8 is shown in the example.
ambiguity: Unclear whether 8 is a sign, house or numerology number.

hindi: इस व्यक्ति का लाइफ में आठ नंबर हाईली नेगेटिव है।
says: For this person the number 8 is highly negative in life.
ambiguity: Numerology not Jyotish; which count (name total, birth date) not said.

hindi: इसकी यहां कुंडली में एक नंबर है।
says: In this person's chart the number 1 is present at the spot he points to.
ambiguity: Number 1 may be the Sun in numerology or the first house; unclear.

hindi: इसका एक नंबर हाईली नेगेटिव है।
says: The number 1 is also highly negative for this person.
ambiguity: Same numerology uncertainty.

hindi: एक तीन छह का लफड़ा डालते हैं।
says: Tries putting the numbers 1, 3 and 6 into the chart, calling them a mess.

A student asks: if the name was started with Pha, with whom would she get along?

hindi: ये वर्ड ऑफ यू छठा आठव के अलावा सबके उपाय किए जा सकते हैं।
says: Remedies can be done for every pairing except the 6th and 8th relations.
ambiguity: Garbled opening; unclear whether the 6/8 pairs are the ones that cannot be remedied.

hindi: छ आठ 12 के अलावा सबके उपाय किए जा सकते हैं।
says: Restated with the 12th added: remedies work for all pairs except 6, 8 and 12.
ambiguity: Conflicts with the earlier advice to change the name sign precisely to fix 6/8/12 pairs.

gist: A student reasons about birth sign and the trik houses and remedies.
A student says the name differences in rashi are what he called trik, 6, 8, 12, and asks about proof.
Reply is cut off: he says he is only telling what was taught, then the sentence ends mid-way.

hindi: दूसरे से राशि होगी किसी भी अच्छे घर में बैठे तो भी झगड़ा होगा
says: If the two partners' signs are in a bad relation (6/8/12) to each other, quarrels will happen even if each one's Moon sits in a good house of his own chart.
cells_derived_method: The rule overrides house strength: a Moon in the 1st, 5th or 10th still gets the pair fault, so house placement does not rescue a 6/8/12 sign pair.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in a trine house in a fire sign, strong alone but still quarrelsome with a 6/8 partner sign.

ambiguity: Start of sentence is cut from the previous block.
classical_check: Differs partly: classical Ashtakoota lets other koota scores offset the rashi fault.

hindi: इसलिए नाम राशि बहुत ज्यादा जरूरी है
says: Because house strength does not save a bad sign pair, the name rashi gets very high priority as the lever to fix it.

gist: A student asks which houses counted from the Moon are favourable for names.

hindi: फेवरेबल नहीं देखने अनफेवरेबल नहीं देखने
says: For naming he does not look for the favourable positions from the Moon; he only checks which positions to avoid.
ambiguity: Caption mixes 'not favourable' and 'not unfavourable'; read as: look only at the unfavourable ones.

hindi: अच्छा दोष तो पता नहीं इतने चंद्रमा इतना सेंसिटिव है दोष ही है इसमें
says: The Moon is so sensitive that some flaw is almost always present in it; he sees it as a fault-prone planet.
ambiguity: First words are garbled.
classical_check: Moon is classically the quickest and most changeable planet; no text says it is always flawed.

hindi: मन दो ढाई दिन तो ठीक रहता है हर ढाई तीन दिन में मूड खराब है
says: The mind stays fine for about two to two and a half days, then the mood turns bad every two and a half to three days, matching the Moon's pace through a sign.
cells_derived_method: Mood dips follow the Moon's sign change; the dip would be stronger when transit Moon crosses the natal 6th, 8th or 12th from natal Moon.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: when transit Moon reaches a debilitated or 8th position the dip is stronger.
Derived, not said by him: Moon in own sign at home position gives the mildest dip.

classical_check: Moon takes about 2.25 days per sign; the mood link agrees with Gochar tradition.

gist: Says that whoever learns this is a king.
Says people often ask him how they can stay smiling and playful like him.
Quips that they do not know how much he cries.
Anyway, they ask how that can be (caption garbled).
Rhetorical question: it is a big thing to be normal after each two and a half days, why is that so?

hindi: क्योंकि जब भी ऐसा हो तो चंद्रमा को उंखलता दो बीच में यानी पागलपन बकवास
says: Whenever the mood cycle drops, give the Moon some unbound playfulness in between, meaning a little crazy nonsense.
ambiguity: The word 'unkhalta' is garbled, perhaps 'unmuktata' (freedom).
classical_check: Silent; behavioural remedy not found in classics.

hindi: वर्ड पे हम जो हमेशा महत्व देते हैं आप बीच में बकवास करो।
says: He stresses the word nonsense, which he always values: do silly talk and play from time to time in the middle of your day.
ambiguity: Starts garbled.

hindi: वो आपके अंदर की खिन्नता को उड़ा देगा।
says: Such playful nonsense will blow away the gloom inside you.

gist: Says we simply never do it.
Rhetorical question: what is it we do not do?
Says a small child does it.
Imitates baby babble.
Says he just saw a small child going into a restaurant.
Repeats that the child is going into the restaurant.
Says the child's parents were walking ahead.
Says the parents were busy in some argument.
Says the child had nothing to do with their argument.
Describes the child holding one hand up.
Says he is eating something.
Says he keeps doing it again.
Says splashes fall and the child does not care.
Says the child enjoys going to party at the restaurant.
Says he was sitting in the restaurant too.
Says he was watching the child come in from outside.
Says he thought he wanted to do the same.
Rhetorical question: we do not do this, and what is the child doing?

hindi: उसका चंद्रमा शुद्ध है।
says: The child's Moon is pure and unafflicted, which is why he is carefree.
ambiguity: Said about a stranger's child, with no chart.

gist: Quotes the child's attitude: let it go to hell, what do I care about anyone.

hindi: साला मरे कोई जिए जिसको यह है उसकी ध्यान ऊर्जा अपने में पूर्ण है।
says: A person whose Moon is pure has his attention energy full within himself, whatever happens to others.

hindi: वो दूसरे से ऊर्जा लेने के लिए भीख मांगेगा ही नहीं।
says: Such a person never begs others for energy or approval.

hindi: उसे सजने सवरने की जरूरत नहीं।
says: He feels no need to dress up and decorate himself for others.

hindi: उसे दूसरे को इंप्रेस करने की जरूरत नहीं।
says: He has no need to impress anybody.

hindi: वो बिंदास होगा।
says: He will be fearless and carefree in manner.

hindi: और बिंदास बंदे के लिए आप कहेंगे यार इसको तो अपनी ऊर्जा दे दे हम।
says: Others are drawn to a carefree person and want to give him their own energy.

gist: Says we are already drained, so instead of taking energy we would give him ours.
Says we just want to connect with such a person.

hindi: ये बच्चे का सुख है।
says: This carefree state is the happiness of a child.

hindi: ये आपके अंदर वात्सल्य है।
says: The attraction we feel is the affection (vatsalya) within us, which he places under the Moon.
ambiguity: Link to the Moon is implied by the next lines.
classical_check: Moon as the karaka of mother-like tenderness is classical.

hindi: ये आपके अंदर बेबीनेस है।
says: This is the babyness, the playful childlike quality, inside you.
ambiguity: Sentence begins at the end of the previous caption block.

hindi: अगर ये आ जाती है तो आपका चंद्रमा ही सेट हो रहा है।
says: If this babyness comes into you, your Moon is being set right.

hindi: ये चंद्रमा का ही उपाय है।
says: Being childlike and playful is itself the remedy for Moon.
classical_check: Silent; classical Moon remedies are white items, Shiva worship, milk.

hindi: हमारे जीवन के अंदर 90% बीमारियां ऐसी हैं जिसका दवाई से कोई लेन देन नहीं।
says: He claims about 90 percent of illnesses in our life have no real connection to medicine; this is a health claim from the lecture and not a medical finding.
ambiguity: The 90 percent figure is unmeasured.

gist: Says we simply do not know.
A student brings up an earlier talk on name rashi and Sikh families having two names.
Student notes one name for home and another for outside.
Student says the name Brajesh Gautam is not becoming famous and work goes only so-so.
Student says work is just going along.
Student asks whether keeping a middle name would make him famous.

hindi: ये ट्रिक है।
says: Taking a second, popular name that activates a better sign is a trick that helps a person become well known.
ambiguity: Refers back to the student's idea of a second name.

gist: Asks the listener whether it was understood.
Gives an example of a man named Devendra Singh.
Says he is called Bittu or Bit by nickname.
Quips that Bit is better.
Says he is very famous under the name Bit.

hindi: तो वो राशि है उसकी एक वो दो राशि एक्टिवेट कर दी उन्होंने विंकी शंटी ये नाम रखे हुए हैं।
says: By taking nicknames like Binkie and Shanty the person has activated a second rashi beside the one of his official name, so he runs on two name signs.
ambiguity: Names are garbled (Winky, Shanty) and the signs involved are not given.

gist: Says such nicknames are common in Sikh families and asks why that person is famous.

hindi: क्योंकि वो नाम जो है वो कहीं बहुत बढ़िया प्लेसमेंट पे बैठ गया।
says: The nickname became famous because its sign lands in a very good placement relative to the person's chart.
ambiguity: No placement test is given.

hindi: इसलिए एक मुंह बोला नाम होता है।
says: That is why a spoken pet name exists: it is the name people actually use for the person.

hindi: चंचल नाम जिसे कहते हैं।
says: This spoken pet name is also called the chanchal name (the restless or playful name).

hindi: वो कुंडली में जिसका एक्टिवेट हो गया गलती से वो उसी नाम से फेमस है।
says: Whoever's pet name happens to activate the right sign in the kundali, even by accident, becomes famous under exactly that name.
ambiguity: Sentence spans two caption blocks.

hindi: उसी नाम से चलो।
says: Advice: go by that activated name and use it in daily life.

hindi: अब सद्गुरु का असली नाम सद्गुरु है।
says: Ironically says Sadhguru's real name is Sadhguru, implying that famous people carry a chosen name rather than the birth name.
ambiguity: Sarcastic; the birth names of these people are not what the fame rests on, which is his point. Unverified claim.

hindi: ओशो का नाम असली ओशो है।
says: Same irony for Osho: the name that made him known is a chosen one.
ambiguity: Sarcasm; no chart is quoted.

hindi: अमिताभ बच्चन का नाम असली अमिताभ बच्चन है।
says: Same irony for Amitabh Bachchan: the famous name is not the one given at birth.
ambiguity: Earlier in this lecture he used Amit/Amar only as a sound example; here the claim is that the public name was a chosen one.

gist: Says this is the muddle in the case.

hindi: अक्षय कुमार का असली नाम अक्षय कुमार है।
says: Same irony for Akshay Kumar: a chosen screen name carries his fame.
ambiguity: Sarcastic phrasing; claims a fixed name is chosen.

hindi: नो ऐसा एक फिक्स नेम रखा जाता है।
says: No, such people fix a deliberate public name for themselves.

hindi: तो वो नाम परिवर्तन से दूसरी राशि एक्टिवेट होती है।
says: The name change activates a different rashi than the birth one.

hindi: वो रॉकेट बनता है।
says: The person then shoots up like a rocket when the new sign suits the chart.
ambiguity: Rapid-rise claim with no measured basis.

hindi: इतना कमाल करती है राशि।
says: Marvels at how much effect the name sign can have.

hindi: पर वो वो नाम आपका फॉर्मल नेम बन जाना चाहिए।
says: But that chosen name must become your formal name, not just a nickname.

hindi: वो मुंह बोला नाम सारी दुनिया में मुंह बोला नाम।
says: The spoken pet name should be the one used across the world.

hindi: सारी दुनिया उसी नाम से पहचानती है आपको।
says: The whole world should know you by that same name.

hindi: पेपर्स में डिफरेंट होता है।
says: In legal papers the name is usually different from the public name.

hindi: पेपर्स में भी हट जाए तो कमाल हो गया।
says: If the name is also changed in the official papers, the effect is excellent.

hindi: लेकिन कई लोग नहीं हटा पा रहे तो भी कॉलिंग नेम चलेगा।
says: If someone cannot change the papers, using the new name as a calling name still works.
ambiguity: This contradicts the earlier rule that the name must become formal.

hindi: कान्हा, कन्हैया, माधव, कृष्ण पता नहीं कितने नाम है उसके।
says: Cites Krishna's many names (Kanha, Kanhaiya, Madhav) as an example of a person known by many calling names.

hindi: लेकिन नाम राशि यदि आपकी आपकी कुंडली के अनुसार स्पेसिफिकली सेट हो गई तो कमाल कर देती है।
says: When the name rashi is set specifically according to your own kundali, it works wonders.
cells_derived_method: The best name sign differs for each lagna and each house sign, so a name-sign table is needed per chart.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with Cancer on the 10th a name sign that supports the career lord sign would be chosen.

hindi: एलर्जी होती है हमारे शरीर के अंदर।

gist: Says there are allergies of every kind in the world.

hindi: ऐसी 90% बीमारियां जिसमें इलाज है ही नहीं क्योंकि मेडिसिन नहीं है।
says: Repeats the 90 percent claim, now saying that these illnesses have no treatment because no medicine exists; a lecture claim, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: Unmeasured figure; different wording from the earlier one.

hindi: वो वो बीमारी है जिसमें शरीर को यह वाली चीज ना खिलाओ तो आप ठीक रहोगे।
says: These are the conditions where simply not feeding the body the offending item keeps you well; avoidance is the cure.
ambiguity: General dietary remark; no medical advice taken.

gist: Says some people cannot take curd.
Says some cannot take rice and some cannot take gram flour.
Says some may not tolerate hot chilli.

hindi: आपको क्या सूट नहीं कर रहा वो आपकी बॉडी ने मना किया नहीं चाहिए।
says: What does not suit you is something your body itself has refused and does not want.

hindi: ये चंद्रमा है।
says: This body-level acceptance or refusal is the work of the Moon.
classical_check: Moon governs body fluids and digestion, which loosely supports this.

hindi: चंद्रमा के अंतर्गत जो आपकी बॉडी के अंदर घुलने मिलने को राजी नहीं।
says: Under the Moon falls whatever the body refuses to mix with or absorb.

hindi: चंद्रमा उसके लिए पूरे शरीर में एलर्जी फैला देता है।
says: For such things the Moon spreads allergy across the entire body.
ambiguity: Health claim, tradition only.

hindi: इसलिए आपके जितने भी एलर्जिक प्रॉब्लम्स हैं उनकी करेक्शन के लिए यानी जिसका इलाज नहीं हो रहा।
says: So for all your allergic problems, especially ones that are not responding to treatment, a different correction is needed.
ambiguity: Sentence leads into the next row.

hindi: आपको होम्योपैथिक मेडिसिन की ओर जाना है।
says: He advises going toward homeopathic medicine for such allergy problems; this is medical advice from the lecture, not endorsed here.

hindi: चंद्रमा के पास होम्योपैथी है।
says: Homeopathy is placed under the Moon's domain.

gist: A student asks what to do if the cause of the allergy is not known.

hindi: हां तो होम्योपैथी मेडिसिन पता ही नहीं चल रहा किस चीज की एलर्जी है लेकिन है।
says: Even when you cannot tell which thing you are allergic to but the allergy exists, he still points to homeopathy.

hindi: पता ही नहीं चल रहा पेट दर्द है पर है।
says: Gives an example: one cannot tell why there is stomach pain, yet it exists.
ambiguity: No diagnosis taken.

hindi: पता ही नहीं चल रहा कि मेरे को सिर में भारीपन है।
says: Another example: an unexplained heaviness in the head.
ambiguity: No diagnosis taken.

hindi: मेरे को पता ही नहीं चल रहा किडनी में प्रॉब्लम ओवरी में कुछ है।
says: Another example: vague kidney or ovary complaints that nobody can pin down.
ambiguity: No diagnosis taken.

hindi: रिपोर्ट सारी ओके वो एलर्जी है बॉडी की।
says: When all medical reports come out normal, he says the cause is a body allergy.
ambiguity: Claim made without a test; not a diagnosis.

hindi: वह सारी एलर्जी चंद्रमा के दोष से है।
says: All such allergies come from a fault in the Moon.
cells_derived_method: Which sign and house carry the Moon fault would decide the part of the body, but he gives no table here.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in a digestion sign in the 6th, a candidate for stomach-type allergy.

classical_check: Silent; classical medical astrology links the Moon to fluids and the stomach.

hindi: आपके चंद्रमा के अंदर दोष है।
says: If you have such allergies, your Moon has a fault.

hindi: चंद्रमा निर्दोष है।
says: He then says the Moon is faultless, setting up the exception in the next sentence.
ambiguity: The sentence is a lead-in; the caption may also read as 'the Moon is not faultless'.

hindi: सिर्फ एक राशि में चार नंबर बाकी सब में कुछ ना कुछ खिचड़ी दोष है।
says: The Moon is flawless only in one sign, number 4 (Cancer, its own sign); in every other sign it has some mixed fault.
cells_derived_method: Judge Moon fault by sign: Cancer clean, every other sign carries some fault, and the fault changes with house, so house and sign both change the reading.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in own sign on the 10th gives a clean Moon, so no allergy fault.
Derived, not said by him: debilitated Moon on the 6th, the most faulty reading, in his scheme.

ambiguity: He ignores exaltation in Taurus, which classical texts treat as also strong.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts call Taurus the Moon's exaltation, not flawed.

hindi: इतना सेंसिटिव है चंद्रमा।
says: The Moon is that sensitive, which is why so many small faults show up in it.
classical_check: Agrees with the Moon being a quick and sensitive planet.

hindi: उसके लिए एलर्जी टेस्ट।
says: For this Moon trouble he points to an allergy test as the practical step.

hindi: एलर्जी टेस्ट कराओ।
says: Instruction: get an allergy test done.
ambiguity: Medical advice from the lecture, recorded only.

gist: Says the funny thing is that allergy tests have their own problem.

Says doctors used to say the reports were fine.
Says nobody knew the cause.
Says then the CT scan arrived.
Says then they said it did not show up on X-ray.
Says it was caught on the CT scan.
Says the problem was then found.
Says then it did not show on the CT and reports were declared fine.
Says then the MRI arrived.
Says the CT is not telling either.
Says it was caught on MRI.
Says the problem is there, only the machine that detects it has not been built yet.

hindi: यह गांठ बांध लो पानी से ठीक होगा
says: Tie this in a knot: the Moon trouble will be cured through water.
ambiguity: Start of the sentence is garbled.
classical_check: Moon is classically the lord of water.

hindi: और पानी का मतलब आपको हर हालत में सूरज अस्त होने के बाद सफेद चीजें अवॉइड करनी है
says: By water he means that after sunset you must in every case avoid white things, namely do not wear or eat them.

classical_check: Moon-ruled white things are normally recommended, not avoided, for a weak Moon; he reverses this for a troubled Moon.

hindi: पहननी नो खानी पानी जो शरीर के अंदर चंद्रमा जा रहा है वो अवॉइड करना है।
says: Avoid wearing white and also avoid the Moon items that go inside the body (white food and drink) after sunset.
ambiguity: Garbled start.

hindi: यानी चावल, दूध, पानी तीन ही चीज तासीर बदल के लो, सफेद चावल ना खाओ, पुलाव के खाओ, कभी खा लो, खा लो कोई दिक्कत नहीं है।
says: The three Moon items to watch are rice, milk and water: change their nature before taking, do not eat plain white rice but eat it as pulao, and an occasional serving is fine.
ambiguity: 'Taseer badal ke' means altering the property by cooking or flavouring.
classical_check: Rice, milk and water as Moon items is classical.

hindi: और बहुत ज्यादा हो रहा है तो मां का मान सम्मान करो, प्रेम करो।
says: If the trouble is severe, honour and love your mother, since mother is the Moon's relative.
classical_check: Agrees: serving the mother is a classical Moon remedy.

hindi: आशीर्वाद लो, आशीर्वाद लेना बहुत जरूरी है।
says: Take blessings (of the mother and elders), which he calls very necessary for the Moon.
ambiguity: Whose blessing is not said, but it follows the line about honouring the mother.
classical_check: Agrees with serving mother and elders as a Moon remedy.

hindi: और होम्योपैथी मेडिसिन लो सारी एलर्जीज़ के लिए
says: Take homeopathic medicine for all allergies; this is the lecture's advice and not endorsed medical advice.

hindi: और 100% एलर्जी होगी।
says: He says allergy will be certain (100 percent) in the weak-Moon charts he is about to list.
ambiguity: Caption order is garbled; the 100 percent is tied to the next sentence's condition. Unmeasured certainty.

hindi: अगर चंद्रमा आपका वीक है एक नंबर और आठ नंबर में बिना नागा चंद्रमा वीक है।
says: A Moon in number 1 or number 8 is always weak without exception; this is his condition for the allergy tendency.
cells_derived_method: The weakness is by house, so sign changes how heavy it is: debilitated Scorpio in the 1st is the worst, exalted Taurus in the 8th is partly cushioned.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: debilitated Moon in the lagna, the worst case of the allergy tendency in his scheme.
Derived, not said by him: exalted Moon in the 8th (lagna Libra), weak by house but strong by sign, mixed.

ambiguity: Numbers 1 and 8 are read as houses because slipping between houses is discussed next; they could also mean signs Aries and Scorpio.
classical_check: Moon in the 8th is classically weak (chidra), Moon in the 1st is not usually called weak.

hindi: इसी के साथ यदि चंद्रमा आपका 12 नंबर का है तो स्लिप हो के वो एक नंबर में शिफ्ट कर सकता है मुन्ना भाई की कुंडली में।
says: A Moon in the 12th can slip into the 1st (house shift, as in bhava chalit) and then counts as weak; he cites a Munna Bhai chart as the example.
cells_derived_method: The slip depends on how close the Moon is to the cusp, so the sign matters: a Moon in the late degrees of the 12th sign slips into the 1st.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in own sign in the 12th (lagna Leo) in late degrees shifts into the lagna and picks up the weakness.
Derived, not said by him: Moon in Pisces in the 12th (lagna Aries) shifts into the lagna if placed near the end of the sign.

ambiguity: Munna Bhai is a nickname of an unknown person; no chart given.
classical_check: Bhava chalit shifting is classical, but its use for allergy is his.

hindi: चंद्रमा दो नंबर का है तो स्लिप करके एक नंबर में जा सकता है।
says: A Moon in the 2nd can also slip backward into the 1st house and so take on the same weakness.
cells_derived_method: A 2nd-house Moon early in its sign slips back; the sign changes the quality of the slip.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in Pisces in the 2nd (lagna Aquarius) at the start of the sign slips into the lagna.
Derived, not said by him: exalted Moon in the 2nd (lagna Aries), the slip is partly protected by its strength.

classical_check: Bhava chalit is classical; the allergy link is his.

hindi: तो जिनका चंद्रमा 12 नंबर का है, दो नंबर का है उनको भी एलर्जी होगी।
says: So people whose Moon is in the 12th or the 2nd house will also have allergy.
ambiguity: Stated as certain; he does not mention degree or the slip condition again.

gist: A student asks him to write the name of the homeopathic medicine.
A student says he does not know what kind of problem needs homeopathy.

hindi: आठ नंबर है तो सात नंबर का भी आठ में स्लिप करेगा और नौ नंबर का भी आठ में स्लिप कर सकता है।
says: For the 8th house, a Moon in the 7th slips forward and a Moon in the 9th can slip back into the 8th, so all three houses give the weak-Moon result.
cells_derived_method: The slip into the 8th depends on degrees within the 7th or 9th sign, so the sign shifts which direction is likely.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in Capricorn in the 7th (lagna Cancer) in late degrees slips into the 8th.
Derived, not said by him: Moon in Libra in the 9th (lagna Aquarius) in early degrees slips back into the 8th.

hindi: तो दो राशि और हो गई हमारे पास।
says: So two more positions (the 7th and the 9th) are added to the list of weak Moon places; he calls them rashis here, meaning houses.
ambiguity: He uses rashi for house numbers.

hindi: तो हमारे पास सात नंबर वाले नौ नंबर राशि के दो नंबर के 12 के एक और आठ एक दो तीन चार पांच छ 12 में से छह हो गए ये आधी जनता को एलर्जी है।
says: Counting the houses 7, 9, 2, 12, 1 and 8, six of the twelve positions give the weak Moon, so he says half of all people have allergy.
cells_derived_method: Moon in the other six houses (3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 11) is outside the allergy group; inside the group, the sign decides the severity.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in own sign in the 10th is outside the six, so no allergy tendency.
Derived, not said by him: debilitated Moon in the 1st is inside the six and strongest.

ambiguity: Half of the population claim is an unmeasured estimate from counting houses.

hindi: और उनका इलाज नहीं है कोई क्योंकि मेडिसिन काम नहीं करती।
says: For these people there is no cure because ordinary medicine does not work on this type of trouble.
ambiguity: Strong medical claim from the lecture, recorded only.

hindi: सिर्फ टेंपरेरी रिलीफ आता है।
says: Medicine gives only temporary relief in these cases.

hindi: उनको होम्योपैथी लेनी पड़ेगी।
says: These people will have to take homeopathy.
ambiguity: Lecture advice, not endorsed.

hindi: नेचुरोपैथी लेनी पड़ेगी।
says: They will also have to take naturopathy.
ambiguity: Lecture advice, not endorsed.

hindi: चंद्रमा के लिए जो बीमारी आपकी ठीक नहीं हो रही जोड़ पकड़ता है।
says: An illness that will not heal and that grips the joints is also a Moon matter.
ambiguity: Garbled opening.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts give joints to Saturn.

hindi: दो हड्डी के बीच का जो कार्टिलेज है वो चंद्रमा है।
says: The cartilage between two bones is the Moon.
classical_check: Differs from classical texts that do not name cartilage.

hindi: चंद्रमा दूषित है कुंडली में जहां वहां का कार्टिलेज वीक है।
says: Where the Moon is afflicted in the chart, the cartilage of the body part tied to that house is weak.
cells_derived_method: The joint depends on the house and sign: a house maps to a body part (3rd arms, 4th chest, 9th thighs, 10th knees, 12th feet), so a Moon in each gives a different joint.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: afflicted Moon in the 10th (knee house) points to knee cartilage.
Derived, not said by him: afflicted Moon in the 12th points to foot and ankle joints.
Derived, not said by him: afflicted Moon in the 3rd points to shoulder, arm or hand joints.

ambiguity: He does not give a house to body-part mapping here.
classical_check: Body-part mapping by houses is classical; the Moon link is his.

hindi: तो हड्डी कड़क-कड़क करेगी।
says: Then the bone will make a cracking, creaking sound.
ambiguity: Symptom, not diagnosis.

gist: Says there should be a gap between the bones.

hindi: ऐसा वो कार्टिलेज घट गया।
says: In that state the cartilage has worn down.

hindi: फिर यहां हड्डी कड़क कड़क टच करती है।
says: Then bone touches bone and creaks.

hindi: रूमेटॉइड अर्थराइटिस ये रुमेटिज्म सब इसी के दोष की वजह से होता है।
says: Rheumatoid arthritis and rheumatism are all caused by this Moon fault; a health claim from the lecture, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Differs: classical medical astrology links joints and rheumatism to Saturn.

gist: Rhetorical question: what do you do for this?

hindi: लुब्रिकेशन चाहिए शरीर में।
says: What the body needs is lubrication of the joints.

hindi: तो उसके लिए तो भोजन इत्यादि है ही जो इसलिए योगा करना है।
says: Food and the like supply this lubrication, but the main step he recommends is yoga.

hindi: बहुत से ऐसे लोग हैं जो योगा करते हैं और चंद्रमा का दोष है कुंडली में दिखता नहीं क्योंकि योगा करके उन्होंने चंद्रमा के द्वारा जो थेरेपी है उसको ऑन कर लिया है।
says: Many yoga practitioners have a Moon fault in the chart, yet it does not show, because yoga has switched on the therapy the Moon provides.

gist: Rhetorical question: how does the Ayurvedic therapy work?

hindi: आयुर्वेदिक दवाई ले ली पाउडर ले लिया अश्वगंधा इत्यादि अन्यथा क्या किया?
says: Ayurvedic medicine is another route, such as ashwagandha powder; the sentence breaks into a question about what else was done.
ambiguity: Question form; lecture advice only.

hindi: प्राणवायु जिन्होंने प्राणवायु के काम कर लिए उन्होंने आयुर्वेद के द्वारा भी ठीक कर लिया।
says: Those who did breath (pranayama) work also healed themselves through Ayurveda.

hindi: जिन्होंने एलोपैथी की दवाई ली और दवाई भी छुटा दी।
says: Some people took allopathic medicine and later managed to leave it.
ambiguity: Sentence continues into the Mars line.

hindi: उन्होंने जिम जाकर के एक्सरसाइज के द्वारा मंगल मंगल के द्वारा भी एलोपैथी की दवाइयां घटा दी या ठीक कर ली।
says: They did so through gym exercise, which belongs to Mars, and cut down or cured the need for allopathic medicine.
classical_check: Mars as the karaka of exercise and strength is classical.

hindi: ऐसे होम्योपैथी के लिए जो एक्सरसाइज है वो आपकी योगा है।
says: The exercise that goes with the Moon's homeopathy is yoga, as the gym is to allopathy.

hindi: तो अगर आप योगा करते हैं तो होम्योपैथी की दवाई की भी जरूरत शायद पड़े ना पड़े लेकिन चंद्रमा का दोष होम्योपैथ से ठीक योगा से ठीक होता है।
says: If you do yoga you may not even need the homeopathy; a Moon fault is mended either by homeopathy or by yoga.

hindi: इसलिए योगा बहुत ज्यादा जरूरी है।
says: Therefore yoga is extremely important for a Moon fault.

hindi: आधी जनता योगा से ही ठीक हो जाएगी।
says: Half the population would be set right by yoga alone.
ambiguity: Unmeasured claim.

hindi: शरीर में जो छुपे हुए दर्द हैं, बैठे-बठाए पेंस हो रहे हैं, यह योगा से ही सेट होंगे।
says: Hidden body pains and pains that arise for no reason will settle only with yoga.

hindi: योग मींस युति।
says: The word yoga means conjunction, the joining of two planets.
ambiguity: He plays on yoga the exercise and yoga the planetary combination.
classical_check: Yoga as union or combination is classical.

gist: Says perfume blocks the third eye.
Says the third eye holds common sense.
Says it gives the power to tell smell from stink.
Says applying perfume blocks the third eye.
Jokes that men turn their heads at women wearing perfume.
Rhetorical what will they do.
Repeats that the third eye is blocked.
Says the man has to look at the woman then.
Rhetorical what to do.
Says it is not beauty, the third eye is simply blocked.
Says a man with long hair may be mistaken for a girl.
Finishes the joke: they will call a long-haired man a girl.
Says a man's sense gets so corrupted.
Says blood circulation stops in a man's frontal lobe.
Garbled sentence about homeopathic medicine and blood circulation in a lobe.
Teases the student for drifting onto homeopathy.
Remarks that talk is of beautiful girls.
Says the boy student's point is right.
A student answers yes.
Tells everyone to drop the digression.

hindi: होम्योपैथी में जो हमें छोटी-छोटी मेडिसिन आती है वो वाइट ही होती है।
says: The small pills used in homeopathy are white, which links them to the Moon.
classical_check: White things as Moon items is classical.

hindi: चंद्रमा ही होता है वो भी।
says: Homeopathy itself also falls under the Moon.

gist: Says they just add water to it.
Jokes that they just put a placebo.
A student asks if it can be used at night after sunset.

hindi: हां हां वो वाइट नहीं है।
says: Yes, the homeopathic pill can be used after sunset because it does not count as white.
ambiguity: Answer to the student's question.

gist: Repeats that it is not white.

hindi: वो तो वाइट प्योर नहीं रहा।
says: The pill is no longer pure white, so it is not a pure Moon item.

hindi: उसमें दवाई आ गई तो तासीर बदल गई।
says: Once medicine enters it, the nature of the substance changes.

hindi: दवाई मंगल है एनी हाउ।
says: Medicine in general is Mars in any case.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts give medicine to Sun, Mars and Mercury together.

gist: A student says the cause of his allergy cannot be found.

hindi: वो भी चंद्रमा।
says: Even an allergy whose cause cannot be found is a Moon matter.

gist: A student agrees.

hindi: यही तो लफड़े वाली एलर्जी है जो पता ही नहीं चल रही।
says: The tricky allergy is exactly the one that cannot be identified.

gist: Says the problem is there.

hindi: लेकिन डॉक्टर ठीक नहीं कर रहा।
says: Yet the doctor is not able to cure it.

hindi: वो सब है चंद्रमा के दोष है एलर्जी है इसलिए पानी के द्वारा सारा कार्यक्रम ठीक होगा
says: All of that is a Moon fault, so the whole thing will be mended through water.
classical_check: Moon as lord of water is classical.

gist: A student says it is hard to say which allergy it is.
Announces the last topic: tattoos and threads.

hindi: अब हमारे पास चंदा मामा का दोष आ गया जी कहीं पर कुंडली के अंदर
says: Sets up the case: somewhere in the kundali the Moon fault has appeared and a remedy is needed.

gist: Rhetorical question: so what do we do now?

hindi: अब हमारी कुंडली एक नंबर की है तो छह नंबर यहां है आठ यहां है 12 यहां है तो एक नंबर का चंद्रमा है तो यह दोष मांगता है।
says: Example chart on the board: the Moon is in the 1st house, with the 6th, 8th and 12th marked, and a Moon in the 1st asks for correction.
cells_derived_method: The correction differs by the sign in the 1st: Cancer in the lagna gives the Moon its own sign and a lighter fault, Scorpio gives debilitation and a heavier one.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon in own sign in the lagna, the lightest fault, a thread may be enough.
Derived, not said by him: debilitated Moon in the lagna, the heaviest fault, may need more than a thread.

ambiguity: Whether 1 is a house or a sign is not clear from caption; the next lines treat it as a house.

gist: Rhetorical question: how will we correct it?

hindi: हम यहां लाल धागा बांधेंगे राइट पैर में।
says: Remedy for the Moon in the 1st: tie a red thread on the right foot.
cells_derived_method: The thread acts like a Mars placed at the house marked by the right foot; whichever house that is, it must aspect the Moon's house, so the house of the Moon changes the answer.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars exalted on the 6th (lagna Leo) aspects the 1st by its 8th aspect, which is the idea behind the right-foot thread.
Derived, not said by him: Mars in Gemini on the 6th (lagna Capricorn), same aspect, a weaker Mars.

ambiguity: He does not state which house the right foot stands for; read as the 6th from the following Mars aspect line.
classical_check: Thread remedies are folk practice, not classical.

hindi: राइट पैर का अंगूठा या पाजेब वाली जगह ये लेफ्ट।
says: The thread goes on the right big toe or where an anklet sits; the left foot is the other position he will use.
ambiguity: Left foot is for a different planet case, in the next section.

hindi: अब यहां से लाल को लेंगे।
says: Now take red from this spot: the red thread is treated as Mars placed at the right-foot position.
ambiguity: Position pointed on the board is not audible.

hindi: आठवीं दृष्टि होती है मंगल की।
says: Mars has an eighth aspect, counting that house from itself.
cells_derived_method: Mars in the 6th aspects the 1st, in the 5th aspects the 12th, and so on; the target house is the house plus 7 steps.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Mars in Aries in the 6th (lagna Scorpio) aspects the 1st by 8th aspect.
Derived, not said by him: Mars in Scorpio in the 3rd (lagna Virgo) aspects the 10th by its 8th aspect.

classical_check: Agrees: Mars aspects the 4th, 7th and 8th houses from itself.

hindi: हमारे इसकी करेक्शन हो गई।
says: With the Mars aspect on the Moon in the 1st, he says the correction is done.

gist: Says good.
Rhetorical question: what else could have been done?

hindi: नौ नंबर यहां है।
says: As the alternative he points to the 9th house on the board.
ambiguity: Whether 9 is a house or a sign number is unclear.

hindi: नौ बेसन यहां दान कर देते।
says: Another way: donate gram flour (besan, a Jupiter item) for the 9th position.
ambiguity: Garbled: 'nau besan' may be 'nau [par] besan'.
classical_check: Gram flour and chana dal as Jupiter donations are classical.

hindi: पांचवी दृष्टि बृहस्पति की होती।
says: Jupiter has a fifth aspect, so Jupiter in the 9th looks at the 1st.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in house H aspects the 5th, 7th and 9th from H, so the effect depends on where Jupiter sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in Libra on the 9th (lagna Aquarius) aspects the 1st by its 5th aspect.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in Gemini on the 12th (lagna Cancer) aspects the 4th by its 5th aspect.

classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter aspects the 5th, 7th and 9th from itself.

hindi: चंद्रमा डाउन।
says: Notes that the Moon is down, meaning weak in this chart.
ambiguity: Could also mean debilitated; unclear.

hindi: ऐसे संकेत आते हैं सिर भारी रहता है इसका हमेशा सिर का भारीपन रहता है
says: Signs of a Moon in the 1st: the head always feels heavy.
cells_derived_method: The 1st house is the head, so a weak Moon there shows in head complaints; the sign of the lagna adds its own flavour.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Aries (head sign) lagna with the Moon, head heaviness is the most direct.
Derived, not said by him: Moon in Pisces in the lagna, heaviness appears more as dullness and tiredness.

ambiguity: Symptom claim, not a diagnosis.

hindi: चेहरे सिर पर चोट का निशान है 1 लाख%
says: There is a scar or injury mark on the face or head, he says with certainty (1 lakh percent).
ambiguity: Exaggerated certainty; unmeasured.

hindi: तो इसके लिए क्या किया राइट पैर में हमने धागा डाल दिया लाल रंग का काम खत्म
says: For this case he put a red thread on the right foot and says the job is done.

hindi: लाल रंग का धागा ना यहां नुकसान करेगा ना यहां नुकसान करेगा ना यहां
says: The red thread will not harm at any of the places it looks at; the Mars effect lands without damage.
ambiguity: Positions are pointed at the board; unreadable. Sentence continues in the next block.

hindi: यह मंगल की तरह बिहेव करेगा मंगल को हमने वहां स्थापित किया है
says: The red thread behaves like Mars, since in effect he has installed Mars at that spot.

hindi: अब यहां की खराबी है यहां चंद्रमा है नहीं चंद्रमा चंदा मामा यहां बैठे हैं खराब इसका क्या करेंगे
says: Next case: a different fault, with the Moon sitting in another weak position, and he asks what to do.
ambiguity: Position is pointed at the board; the 8th is a guess from the next line about a number 8 case.

hindi: इसके लिए चंदा मामा के लिए हम लेफ्ट लेफ्ट पैर में येलो धागा डालेंगे।
says: For this second Moon fault, tie a yellow thread on the left foot.
cells_derived_method: The yellow thread acts as Jupiter at the house of the left foot, and it must aspect the Moon's house, so the Moon's house decides which foot position works.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in own sign on the 12th (lagna Aries) aspects the 4th and the 8th, so it supports a Moon in the 8th and the property house.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter in Sagittarius on the 12th (lagna Capricorn) gives the same aspects with a different 4th and 8th lord.

ambiguity: Left foot linked to the 12th house is derived, not said.

gist: Says the yellow thread has been put on.

hindi: येलो धागा यहां से यहां देख रहा है।
says: The yellow thread, acting as Jupiter, looks from its place to the Moon's house.
ambiguity: Houses pointed at the board are not audible.
classical_check: Jupiter aspect is classical; the thread as Jupiter is not.

hindi: लाजवाब कर देगा।
says: The Jupiter aspect will make the result excellent.

hindi: यहां से यहां देख रहा है।
says: The yellow thread also looks at a second house from the same place.
ambiguity: Second aspect target is the 4th house in the following line.
classical_check: Jupiter has three aspects, so two targets are normal.

hindi: चार नंबर हो गया।
says: The second aspect lands on the 4th house.
ambiguity: 4 taken as house number, not sign.

hindi: चीज और बना देगा।
says: With the 4th house strengthened it will help build more things, meaning more possessions.
classical_check: 4th as home and possessions is classical.

hindi: प्रॉपर्टी और बन जाएगी।
says: More property will also come, as the 4th house is helped by the Jupiter aspect.
ambiguity: Property gain claim, not investment advice.

hindi: तो पैर में जो दर्द होता है इस बंदे के पैर के तले में दर्द होता है।
