hindi: चाहे वो कोई भी राशि के हो चंद्र शनि चंद्र राहु चंद्र केतु चंद्र मंगल चंद्र गुरु सूर्य चंद्र
says: He says the Moon's pair results (Moon with Saturn, Rahu, Ketu, Mars, Jupiter, Sun) are to be read by the planet pair alone, in whatever sign the pair falls. The partner planet sets the mind's flavour; sign is not the deciding factor in this lesson.
cells_derived_method: Pair meaning is sign-independent as he states it. The house the pair sits in decides which life area shows the mental trait (4th = home/mother, 10th = work, 7th = partner).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon with Saturn here would show the suppressed, quiet mind as a restrained home atmosphere and a reserved relationship with mother.
Derived: Moon with Jupiter here would show the dominant-but-principled temperament in career and public standing.

ambiguity: Whether he really ignores sign dignity or only for this quick overview is not clear.
classical_check: Differs in part: classical texts weigh sign and dignity of the Moon (for example Moon in Taurus or Cancer), not only the partner.

hindi: चंद्रमा और सूर्य साथ यदि हैं तो यह नेगेटिव है चंद्रमा एक्लिप्स रहेगा छुपा रहेगा तो ऐसे में मन दबा रहेगा
says: Moon and Sun together is negative: the Moon stays eclipsed and hidden under the Sun, so the person's mind stays pressed down and cannot show itself.
cells_derived_method: Same suppression in every sign. House changes where the hidden mind shows: in the 1st it hides the self, in the 4th hides feelings at home, in the 7th hides feelings in partnership.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun and Moon in the Sun's own sign in the 1st house; strong ego, but feelings are covered by authority and pride.
Derived: Sun and Moon in the 7th; the partner side shows an inner reluctance to express feelings, mind dominated by the spouse or public.

classical_check: Agrees in spirit: new-moon births and a combust Moon are weak for the mind in classical texts.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्ति जो होते हैं हमेशा दूसरे की कमांड लेकर के चलते हैं और दूसरे की कमांड में सुखी रहते हैं
says: People with Sun and Moon together keep taking orders from others and are actually comfortable and happy living under someone else's command.
cells_derived_method: none; a temperament claim. Houses only change whose command it is (4th mother, 7th spouse, 10th boss).
ambiguity: Refers to the Sun-Moon pair of the previous sentence; the caption does not repeat it.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not describe this obedience trait specifically.

hindi: अपनी कमांड बना के चलेंगे लाइफ में प्रॉब्लम्स आएंगी दूसरे के अनुसार
says: If a Sun-Moon person tries to run life by their own command, problems arrive; they do better following another person's direction.
cells_derived_method: none; temperament claim not house or sign specific.
ambiguity: The last words 'दूसरे के अनुसार' are cut; could mean 'problems will arrive as per others' doing' or 'they must go as per others'. Read as the second.

hindi: चंद्रमा बृहस्पति साथ पक्की दादागिरी है कुछ भी कर लो अपने हिसाब से ही चलेंगे
says: Moon with Jupiter gives a firm bossy streak: whatever you do, this person will go his own way and will not bend to others.
cells_derived_method: Dominance trait holds across signs. House sets the arena: 1st self-will, 5th over children/students, 10th over staff and public.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon and Jupiter in Jupiter's own sign in the 5th; wise, commanding teacher or parent who sets the rules for children or students.
Derived: Moon in own sign with exalted Jupiter in the 10th; firm authority in career, people follow his lead.

classical_check: Partly differs: classical texts call this Gajakesari-type combination wise and respected rather than domineering.

hindi: राजयोग कहते हैं इसको गजकेसरी योग बना देते हैं लोग
says: Classical books call Moon with Jupiter a raja yoga, and people label it Gajakesari yoga.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Gajakesari is Jupiter in a kendra (1, 4, 7, 10) from the Moon; a conjunction is the 1st-from-Moon case, so it counts.

hindi: पर जरूरी नहीं यह दादागिरी योग है एक्चुअली कि मेरी ही चलेगी किसी और के बाप की नहीं चलेगी
says: He says it need not be a raja yoga in the usual sense; in practice he calls it a dominance yoga where only the native's will runs and nobody else's.
cells_derived_method: none; reinterprets the yoga's behaviour. House only gives the arena.
classical_check: Differs from classical text, which reads the yoga as fame, wealth and wisdom, not stubborn dominance.

hindi: लेकिन मर्यादा से चलेगी यह इसका सबसे पॉजिटिव पॉइंट है
says: Yet the Moon-Jupiter dominance runs within propriety and limits; he calls this the pair's best positive point.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical view that Jupiter brings dharma and restraint to the Moon.

hindi: कि यह इतना जेन्युइन कार्य करेगा कि ऐसे व्यक्ति को आप पैसे दे सकते हो
says: A Moon-Jupiter person works so genuinely and honestly that one can safely hand money to him.
cells_derived_method: none; honesty trait, not house or sign specific.
classical_check: Silent on trust with money; Jupiter as honest and dharmic is consistent.

hindi: अगर किसी का चंद्रमा अच्छा है तो उस व्यक्ति को आप लाखों रुपए दे दो वो खाएगा नहीं मरता मर जाएगा पैसे नहीं जाने वाले
says: If someone's Moon is good, you can give that person lakhs of rupees; he will not eat the money and your money is safe even if he must suffer. This is a trust claim only, not financial advice.
cells_derived_method: none; reliability of a well-placed Moon, sign and house not specified.
ambiguity: 'Good Moon' is undefined: strong sign, waxing, or well aspected is not stated.

hindi: हमें कोई कहता है ना पार्टनर देख लो कैसा है तो पहले हम
says: When people ask him to check how a business or life partner is, he says what he looks at first (completed in the next sentence). It sets up the Moon as the first test of a person.
cells_derived_method: none; method of partner assessment, not house or sign dependent as stated.
ambiguity: Sentence is cut at the timestamp; the object 'Moon' comes in the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent on this method; classical partner checks use the 7th house and its lord.

hindi: चंद्रमा देखते हैं कि चंद्रमा कैसा है इसका मन कैसा है
says: To judge a partner or any person, he first reads the Moon in the chart, because it shows what the person's mind is like.
cells_derived_method: none; the Moon is the mind karaka everywhere.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is the karaka of the mind.

hindi: क्या दूसरे के धन को देख के ललाई हो जाएगा क्योंकि पानी किसी चीज में मिला दो वैसा हो जाता है
says: He asks whether the person will turn greedy on seeing another's wealth, because the Moon is water and takes the colour of whatever is mixed in; so the planets joined to the Moon decide the mind's nature.
cells_derived_method: none; explains why the Moon's conjunction partner colours the mind.
classical_check: Agrees in idea: the Moon is changeable and takes on the nature of its conjunct or aspecting planets.

hindi: चंद्रमा मंगल उग्र महान उग्रता इतनी उग्रता रहेगी बात बातबात पे उबाल खा रहे हैं
says: Moon with Mars makes the mind fierce and hot-tempered; the person boils over at every small thing.
cells_derived_method: Temper trait is the same in every sign; house decides where it flares: 4th at home and with mother, 7th in partnership, 10th at work.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign with Mars debilitated in the 4th; heated moods and anger within the home.
Derived: Moon with Mars in Mars's own sign in the 10th; quick temper and forceful action at work.

classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical Chandra-Mangala yoga also gives a hot, bold mind.

hindi: चंद्रमा इंद्र बस ऐश करनी भाई बात करनी तो पहले बढ़िया माहौल होना चाहिए
says: Moon with Uranus (Indra) is a pleasure-seeking mind: for even a simple talk it wants a fine, comfortable setting first.
cells_derived_method: Indra trait is sign-independent as stated. House gives the area of luxury-seeking (2nd food and style, 4th home comforts, 11th social circle).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon with Uranus in a Venus sign in the 2nd; refined taste in food and speech settings.
Derived: Moon with Uranus in the 11th; wants stylish, social gatherings as the setting for talk.

classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not use Uranus.

hindi: क्या खाएगा कि यार धांसू से रेस्टोरेंट चल भाई बड़ी धांसू है
says: As an example of the Moon-Uranus mind, the person insists on a swanky restaurant even for a simple meal, because the surroundings matter as much as the food.
cells_derived_method: none; illustration of the previous trait.

gist: Caption 'उनकी तो प्लेटेंट ही बड़ी धांसू है' is garbled; probably praising the restaurant's food or style.
Mimics a person admiring a restaurant's ambience; acting out the Moon-Uranus example.
Short filler saying 'this is the state of such a person'.

hindi: चंद्रमा शुक्र पार्टी चलेगी।
says: Moon with Venus makes a party-loving mind: the person wants gatherings and enjoyment going on all the time.
cells_derived_method: Trait holds in every sign. House gives the field: 5th romance and entertainment, 7th partner and social life, 11th friends.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted with Venus in own sign in the 5th; love of romance, arts and entertainment.
Derived: Moon with Venus in Libra in the 11th; large social circle, frequent parties and outings.

classical_check: Agrees: classical Moon-Venus is pleasure-loving, fond of luxury and company.

hindi: चाहे कुछ भी हो बिना पार्टी के काम नहीं करेंगे।
says: Moon-Venus people will not do any task without a party or celebration attached; mood and enjoyment come first.

hindi: और भैया जब तक थोड़ा राग रंग और ऐश नीम डलेगी ना बीच में काम नहीं होगा।
says: Work for the Moon-Venus mind does not move until a little music, colour and luxury are mixed in; without that atmosphere the task stalls.
ambiguity: The word 'ऐश नीम' is garbled; read as 'ऐश-इशरत' (luxury).

hindi: यह व्यसन भी कराता है।
says: Moon with Venus can also lead the person into vices or addictive habits of indulgence. This is a tradition claim about habits, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: none; risk claim. Houses 2, 5 or 12 would plausibly intensify it, but he does not say so.
classical_check: Agrees in general: afflicted Venus and Moon are linked to indulgence in classical texts.

gist: Repeats that it brings addiction, adding 'along with it'.

hindi: चंद्रमा केतु दबा हुआ है।
says: Moon with Ketu leaves the mind pressed down and withdrawn.
cells_derived_method: Withdrawal trait in every sign. House gives the area: 4th inner peace and home detachment, 7th detachment in partnership, 12th moksha-type isolation.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon with Ketu in Pisces in the 4th; deep inward, spiritual withdrawal and detachment from home life.
Derived: Moon with Ketu in the 7th; emotional distance in partnership, indifference to social bonds.

classical_check: Agrees: Moon with Ketu is classically a detached, confused or mystic mind.

hindi: क्या रखा है संसार में?
says: The Moon-Ketu mind asks what is there in the world worth chasing; it sees worldly aims as hollow.
classical_check: Agrees with Ketu as the vairagya (renunciation) planet.

hindi: कोई फायदा नहीं है किसी बात का।
says: Such a person feels no purpose or gain in any effort, so ambition and drive weaken.

hindi: मजे करो जियो।
says: The Moon-Ketu attitude also swings to 'just enjoy and live', a carefree acceptance without planning.

hindi: अपने आप में जियो अंतर्मन में चले जाओ।
says: The Moon-Ketu person lives inside himself and turns toward the inner mind rather than the outer world.
classical_check: Agrees with Ketu's introspective, spiritual nature.

hindi: किसी से बात की जरूरत नहीं है।
says: Such a person feels no need to talk to anyone, so social contact drops.

hindi: इंट्रोवर्ट बहुत इंट्रोवर्ट बनाता है।
says: Moon with Ketu makes the native very introverted.
cells_derived_method: none; summary label for the Moon-Ketu pair.

hindi: लेकिन चंद्रमा शनि सबसे ज्यादा इंट्रोवर्ट बनाता है।
says: He ranks Moon with Saturn as the most introverted of all Moon pairs, even more than Moon with Ketu.
cells_derived_method: Introversion is sign-independent as stated. Houses 1, 4 or 12 would make it most visible; Saturn's own signs (Capricorn, Aquarius) make it more disciplined than gloomy.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon with Saturn in Saturn's own sign in the 12th; extremely private, solitary and withdrawn.
Derived: Moon with Saturn in Capricorn in the 1st; serious, reserved personality, slow to open up.

classical_check: Agrees: Moon-Saturn (Punarphoo) is classically heavy, reserved and melancholic.

hindi: वैसे चंद्रमा और वरुण तूफान मचा रखा है।
says: Moon with Neptune (Varuna) creates a storm: the mind is turbulent and stirred up.
cells_derived_method: Turbulence is sign-independent as stated. House shows where the storm lands: 4th at home, 5th in love and children, 12th in sleep and imagination.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon with Neptune in Libra in the 5th; stormy, idealised romances and emotional intensity with children.
Derived: Moon with Neptune in Pisces in the 12th; vivid dreams, restless nights, strong imagination.

classical_check: Silent; Neptune is not a classical planet.

hindi: आग लगा रखी है।
says: The Moon-Neptune mind keeps things on fire, meaning the person is restless and provocative.
cells_derived_method: none; adds to the storm description.

hindi: किसी के बाप की नहीं सुनेंगे।
says: A Moon-Neptune person listens to nobody at all; he cannot be told what to do.
ambiguity: This sentence begins at the end of the previous chunk and ends in the next.

hindi: अपने हिसाब से चलेंगे और जो करना है ना खुल के करेंगे छुप के नहीं करेंगे बिल्कुल खुल के
says: Moon-Neptune people follow their own way and do what they want openly, without hiding.
ambiguity: Contradicts the usual Neptune idea of secrecy; he states open action here.

hindi: कई दिनों में जब बच्चा बिल्कुल बदतमीज और अडियम मूडी हो जाता है ना तो चंद्रमा घूम के वरुण की राशि में घूम रहा होता है उन ढाई ढाई दिनों में
says: When a child turns rude, stubborn and moody for a couple of days, the transiting Moon is passing through Neptune's sign in the child's chart. The Moon spends about two and a half days in each sign.
cells_derived_method: Which sign is Neptune's sign changes with his scheme (Libra or Pisces candidates). House: the moody phase would touch the house of that sign in the natal chart.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: if Libra is Neptune's sign, a Moon transit through it lasting 2.5 days gives stubborn moods that relate to the 7th-house area (partners, others).
Derived: if Pisces were used, the same 2.5-day phase would show in sleep and withdrawal themes.

ambiguity: He does not say which sign is Neptune's; in his scheme Libra is the usual candidate.
classical_check: Moon transit effects exist in classical gochar; Neptune's sign does not.

hindi: उसकी कुंडली में तो बिल्कुल अडियल सडियल हो जाता है वो
says: In those days of the Moon in Neptune's sign, the child becomes completely obstinate and sulky; the effect is seen in the chart of the person.
cells_derived_method: none; same as the previous transit claim.
ambiguity: Restates the previous transit claim with added 'in his chart'.

hindi: चंद्रमा और यम घुटा हुआ बीमार
says: Moon with Pluto (Yama) makes the mind choked and sickly, a suffocated and heavy state.
cells_derived_method: Suffocation trait is sign-independent as stated. House points to the field: 4th home peace, 6th illness area, 8th hidden fears.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon with Pluto in Scorpio in the 8th; intense hidden emotional pressure and brooding.
Derived: Moon with Pluto in the 4th; heavy, closed atmosphere at home and in the mind.

ambiguity: 'बीमार' may refer to the mind, not the body.

hindi: उन दिनों के ढाई ढाई दिन के छोटे छोटे-थोड़े फीवर होते हैं ना लोगों को बीमार पड़ गए उन दिनों में
says: He links short two-and-a-half-day bouts of mild fever to days when the transiting Moon is in Pluto's sign. This is a health observation, not a medical diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Which sign is Pluto's sign matters (Scorpio or Aquarius candidates); house of that sign in the natal chart would indicate which area suffers.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: if Scorpio is Pluto's sign and it falls in the 6th, the Moon's 2.5-day pass would be the likely sick days.
Derived: if Aquarius is Pluto's sign, the 2.5-day pass is felt as heaviness around the 8th-house area.

ambiguity: He does not name which sign belongs to Pluto here.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts link Moon transits in the 6th or 8th from natal Moon to discomfort, not Pluto.

hindi: ये वो वाले दिन है क्या आज तबीयत खराब है बस पता नहीं क्यों खराब है
says: He tells people to recognise such days: feeling unwell for no known reason may simply be the Moon passing Pluto's sign.

hindi: इसका बहुत अच्छा इलाज है यमराज इसका इलाज है कॉफी पी लो चाय लो राहु बहुत हेल्प करता है
says: The remedy for the Pluto-Moon unwell days is to drink coffee or tea; he says Rahu helps greatly, so stimulants are tied to Rahu as a cure for Yama's heaviness. A tradition claim, not medical advice.
cells_derived_method: none; general remedy for those days.
ambiguity: The caption 'यमराज इसका इलाज है' is unclear: could mean Yama's cure or Yama is the cause.
classical_check: Silent; coffee-Rahu link is his own scheme.

hindi: बहुत ज्यादा चंद्रमा राहु ये वैसे ही कूड़ा खचा हुआ है
says: Moon with Rahu fills the mind with junk, clutter and worry.
cells_derived_method: Clutter trait sign-independent as stated. House shows the area: 4th mind and home, 5th thoughts and children, 12th sleep.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted with Rahu in the 4th; strong emotions mixed with obsession and unrest at home.
Derived: Moon with Rahu in Virgo in the 10th; overthinking and anxiety about work and image.

classical_check: Agrees: Moon with Rahu is a classic combination for obsessive, anxious thinking (grahan-type yoga).

hindi: चंद्रमा राहु वाला व्यक्ति इतना ज्यादा कुड़ता है इतना खींचता है उसके मन पे भयंकर रोग है
says: The Moon-Rahu person frets and strains his mind so much that it becomes a severe affliction of the mind. This is a tradition claim on mental restlessness, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: 'रोग' may mean heavy mental distress, not a clinical illness.
classical_check: Agrees in general: Rahu-Moon affliction is classically linked to mental disturbance.

hindi: बहुत ज्यादा आवश्यक है इसका बृहस्पति यहां स्थापित करना जैसी राशि है उसके अनुसार बृहस्पति की स्थापना चाहिए
says: For Moon-Rahu it is very necessary to establish Jupiter, in the way that suits the sign of the placement. He means a Jupiter remedy fitted to the sign the pair occupies.
cells_derived_method: The Jupiter remedy changes with the sign and house of the Moon-Rahu pair: house topic decides the area to support, sign decides the form.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for Moon-Rahu in the 4th in Gemini, Jupiter support would be directed to home and mother matters and a Mercury-type sign style.
Derived: for Moon-Rahu in the 10th in Scorpio, Jupiter support would work on career guidance and ethical conduct.

ambiguity: 'यहां स्थापित करना' may mean physical placement or planting Jupiter's influence in the chart; unclear.
classical_check: Agrees in principle: Jupiter's aspect is the classical cure for Rahu's affliction.

hindi: बृहस्पति कहीं से भी राहु को ऊपर देख ले तो चंद्रमा को सांस आएगा
says: If Jupiter aspects Rahu from anywhere in the chart, the Moon-Rahu mind finally gets relief and room to breathe.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's aspect needs the 5th, 7th or 9th from Jupiter to land on the Moon-Rahu house; the house count decides which Jupiter positions help.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for Moon-Rahu in the 4th, Jupiter in the 8th, 10th or 12th house (5th, 7th, 9th from it) would relieve it.
Derived: for Moon-Rahu in the 7th, Jupiter in the 11th, 1st or 3rd would give the aspect that relieves it.

ambiguity: 'ऊपर देख ले' means look at Rahu by aspect; he does not name the 5th, 7th, 9th.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter's aspect on a Rahu-afflicted Moon is a classic mitigation.

hindi: राहु नहीं तो इसको पकड़ लेता है जकड़ लेता है बड़ी बुरी तरह से तंग करता है
says: If there is no Jupiter aspect, Rahu grabs and holds the Moon tightly and torments the mind badly.
cells_derived_method: none; the negative case of the previous rule, house sets where the grip is felt.
ambiguity: The caption reads 'राहु नहीं तो' which means 'otherwise Rahu'; the 'if not Jupiter' is implied.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical Rahu-Moon affliction.

hindi: चंद्रमा बुध मां क्लेश जहां गए भाई साहब पहले तो बहस करेंगे
says: Moon with Mercury brings quarrels, arguments and tension (he also says 'mother', possibly mother-related conflict); wherever such a person goes he begins with an argument.
cells_derived_method: Argumentative trait is sign-independent as stated. House points to the field: 3rd siblings and talk, 4th mother, 7th spouse.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon with Mercury in Virgo in the 4th; arguments and verbal friction with mother and at home.
Derived: Moon with Mercury in Gemini in the 3rd; endless debating with siblings and neighbours.

ambiguity: The word 'मां' is unclear: could be 'mother' or a filler.
classical_check: Differs partly: classical Moon-Mercury is clever and talkative, not mainly quarrelsome.

hindi: भाई बात बाद में होगी हिसाब बाद में होगा खाना बाद में खाएंगे पहले हम करेंगे बहस
says: For the Moon-Mercury person, argument comes first; the actual talk, the accounts and even the meal can wait until the debate is done.

hindi: क्योंकि बुध कहता है मैं तो मेरे दम पर ही चलेगा
says: The cause given: Mercury insists on running everything on its own strength, so the Moon-Mercury mind acts self-reliantly and refuses to yield.
cells_derived_method: none; reason for the argumentative trait.

hindi: तू यह वो बिगड़ैल बच्चा है जो अपने नाजायज से लड़ता है वो कुछ नहीं कर सकता
says: He compares the Moon-Mercury person to a spoiled child who fights with his own ill-founded demands and ends up able to do nothing; the caption here is rough.
ambiguity: 'अपने नाजायज से' is garbled; may mean 'with an illegitimate person' or 'with his own wrong wants'.

gist: Says these are only the rough, broad states of each Moon pair.

hindi: चंद्रमा शनि मन घुटा हुआ है।
says: With Moon and Saturn the mind is choked and held tight.
cells_derived_method: Same suppression in every sign; Saturn's own signs make it disciplined, a Venus sign softens it. House shows where it stifles.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon with Saturn in Capricorn in the 2nd; speech is stifled and cautious, hard to express feelings in family talk.
Derived: Moon with exalted Saturn in the 9th; serious, tradition-bound thinking, heavy about beliefs.

hindi: दबा हुआ है।
says: He adds that the Moon-Saturn mind is pressed down under weight, a sense of feeling squashed.
cells_derived_method: none; same statement in other words.

hindi: बोल नहीं पा रहे बस थायरॉइड के पेशेंट बन जाते हैं।
says: Unable to speak out, such Moon-Saturn people become thyroid patients, he claims. This is a medical statement recorded as his tradition claim only, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: none; throat (5th chakra) link via suppressed speech.
classical_check: Silent; thyroid is not tied to Moon-Saturn in classical texts.

gist: Rhetorical question: how would such people speak?
Voices the Moon-Saturn native: 'I just cannot speak'.

hindi: इसलिए शनि की दृष्टि भी चंद्रमा पर आ गई।
says: So Saturn's aspect also falls on the Moon, which adds to the same choked-mind result.
cells_derived_method: Aspect counts relative house positions of Saturn and Moon (3, 7, 10 from Saturn); sign adds nothing to the count.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in the 4th aspected by Saturn from the 6th, 10th or 2nd (3rd, 7th, 10th from Saturn); the home and mother area feels heavy.
Derived: Moon in the 10th aspected by Saturn from the 8th, 4th or 1st; career emotions held down.

ambiguity: Starts as a consequence ('so'), the full cause is the previous Moon-Saturn lines.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn aspecting the Moon is classically harmful for peace of mind.

hindi: तीसरी, सातवीं, दसवीं तो भी वो घुटा हुआ है।
says: Saturn's special aspects are the 3rd, 7th and 10th from itself; when any of them touches the Moon, the mind stays choked.
cells_derived_method: Count 3, 7 or 10 houses from Saturn; the Moon in that house is aspected. Signs follow the same counting.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in the 1st, 5th or 4th house would aspect a Moon in the 7th (7th from 1st, 3rd from 5th, 10th from 4th).
Derived: Saturn in the 6th, 10th or 3rd would aspect a Moon in the 12th.

gist: Again says the mind is choked.

hindi: बच्चे के मार्क्स नहीं आते।
says: A child with Moon under Saturn does not get good marks in studies because the mind is held down.
cells_derived_method: Study results link to the 4th and 5th houses; those houses would show the area in a given chart.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon with Saturn in the 5th; slow, burdened learning and pressure in exams.
Derived: Moon with Saturn in the 4th; study environment feels heavy and results lag.

classical_check: Silent; classical texts link low marks to weak Mercury and the 4th/5th houses.

gist: Says that whatever you do, the marks problem does not change.

hindi: शनि से आजाद करना पड़ेगा।
says: To fix this the Moon must be freed from Saturn's grip; the remedy aims at loosening Saturn's hold on the mind.
cells_derived_method: none; the form of release depends on the chart.

gist: Lead-in saying there is a rough, general remedy for it.

hindi: खजूर देने चाहिए मंदिर में।
says: As the rough remedy for a Saturn-pressed Moon, offer dates (khajoor) at a temple.
cells_derived_method: none; applies to the Moon-Saturn pair in general.
classical_check: Silent; dates are not a standard classical remedy.

hindi: मतलब डिपेंड्स कुंडली के हिसाब से।
says: He cautions that the remedy given depends on the actual chart; it is not a fixed prescription for every case.
cells_derived_method: none; general caution about all remedies.
classical_check: Agrees: remedies are chart-specific in classical practice.

gist: Audience member says 'sir, just one last question'.
A one-word 'yes' exchanged.
Audience remarks the last question was already asked earlier.
Says they used to give this second-to-last question first.
Clarifies it is the second-last one that is the last.
Teacher's 'yes' to go ahead.
Audience restates 'second last question'.
Start of the audience question 'sir, this...' carried to the next line.
Audience asks whether upper arm and wrist are the same place for tying threads or tattoos, or different.

hindi: जिन लोगों को टैटू यहां नहीं करा पा रहे।
says: For people who are unable to get a tattoo on this arm zone, he offers a simpler substitute (the thread in the next lines).
cells_derived_method: none; introduction to the substitute remedy.
ambiguity: 'यहां' is a spoken gesture to the arm or wrist area; the location is not in the caption.
classical_check: Silent; tattoos are not a classical remedy.

hindi: टैटू करना एक काम है भाई।
says: He says getting a tattoo is a real task and effort, which is why not everyone does it.

hindi: काटापाटी करो फिर कई लोग डरते हैं।
says: The cutting and piercing involved in tattooing scares many people, so they avoid the tattoo remedy.

hindi: नहीं हो रहा कल करेंगे।
says: Fearful people keep postponing the tattoo ('not happening now, will do tomorrow').

hindi: धागा घर यहां बांध लो फटाफट हाथों हाथ।
says: Instead of a tattoo, tie a thread at the same arm or wrist zone immediately, as a quick substitute.
cells_derived_method: none; thread colour and planet are to be chosen per chart in the next lines.
ambiguity: 'धागा घर' seems a caption slip for 'धागा'.
classical_check: Agrees that tied threads (kalava, planet colours) are traditional remedies.

gist: Caption 'ये पूरा ज़ोन यू माना जाता है' is garbled; meaning unclear.

hindi: अच्छा ये एक ज़ोन है।
says: The arm and wrist area is treated as one zone for the remedy, not as separate spots.
cells_derived_method: none; defines the zone, which the next lines tie to the 4th and 10th houses.

hindi: फोर्थ और 10थ।
says: He names the zone's houses as the 4th and 10th.
cells_derived_method: none; the 4th and 10th are the kendra axis of home and work.
ambiguity: Likely means the arm zone relates to the 4th and 10th houses.
classical_check: Silent on an arm-zone mapping; 4th and 10th are kendra houses classically.

hindi: चौथा और दवां घर यह जोन है आपका बहुत पावरफुल इफेक्ट आएगा
says: The 4th and 10th house zone on the arm is powerful; a remedy applied here will have a very strong effect.
cells_derived_method: Houses 4 and 10 are both kendras; strength of the remedy follows the chart's 4th and 10th conditions.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: if a negative planet sits in the 4th in Scorpio, work at this zone would target home peace and mother.
Derived: if the 10th house is weak in Leo, the same zone would target career standing and authority.

ambiguity: 'दवां' is 'दसवां' (tenth) misheard.

hindi: जितना दिल के पास होगा हृदय के पास वो यह वाला इलाका है सेकंड लेवल पे ये आएगा ग्रेड थ्री
says: The nearer the remedy sits to the heart, the stronger it is; this arm zone is not the closest, so he ranks it second level, grade three.
cells_derived_method: none; ranking of body zones for remedies.
ambiguity: The 'second level, grade three' wording is unclear.

gist: Says people do it as a compromise: it is a deal made of necessity.
Casual wrap-up that this is fine and done.
Lead-in phrase before naming silver for the Moon.

hindi: चंद्रमा के लिए चांदी पहनने को बोलते हैं
says: For the Moon, astrologers advise wearing silver.
classical_check: Agrees: silver is the Moon's metal in classical practice.

hindi: बहुत अच्छा करते हैं
says: He endorses silver for the Moon as a good practice that astrologers rightly advise.
ambiguity: Could be an aside about the astrologers; read as approval of silver.
classical_check: Agrees with silver for the Moon.

hindi: एक बिना जोड़ वाला छल्ला बताते ते हैं।
says: The silver is advised as a seamless ring (chhalla) with no joint.

hindi: बिना जोड़ का कड़ा बताते हैं।
says: Alternatively a seamless bangle (kada) is advised, again without a joint.

hindi: यह शुक्र के लिए शुक्र बन जाता है।
says: He says this seamless silver piece also acts for Venus, that is, silver serves as a Venus remedy as well.
ambiguity: Caption is circular ('for Venus it becomes Venus'); read as silver or the ring is a Venus item too.
classical_check: Partly: silver is classically for the Moon; white metals are also used for Venus.

hindi: तो यह सारी की सारी कुंडली के अनुसार है।
says: All these remedies are to be chosen according to the actual chart, not given blindly.

hindi: डिपेंड करता है क्या जरूरत है, क्या नहीं है।
says: What to use depends on what the person needs and what he does not need; the astrologer has to judge necessity.

hindi: उपाय एंडलेस है।
says: Remedies are endless; there is no fixed final list.

hindi: कई उपाय आप अपने आप बना सकते हो।
says: You can create many remedies on your own once you understand the planet and the need.
classical_check: Differs from strict scriptural remedies; he allows self-invented ones.

hindi: आउट ऑफ एक्सपीरियंस।
says: He says such self-made remedies come out of experience rather than from texts.

hindi: अब हमारे अपने आप ही बने हुए हैं ये कलर शर के और भी कई चीजें हैं।
says: His self-made remedies include colours and several other items he devised himself; the caption names colour but is rough.
ambiguity: 'कलर शर के' is garbled; read as colours and so on.

hindi: पानी में फेंका जाता है।
says: One of these remedies is to throw an item into water, a flowing-water disposal remedy.
classical_check: Agrees that flowing water offerings appear in traditional remedies.

hindi: ये चौथे घर में है।
says: He sets an example where the matter sits in the 4th house, the house of home, mother and peace.
cells_derived_method: 4th house is the home, mother, property and peace of mind; sign in it sets the flavour of the issue.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: trouble in the 4th in Aries shows as heated conflict at home.
Derived: trouble in the 4th in Cancer shows as emotional distress tied to mother and house.

classical_check: Agrees that the 4th house is home and mother.

hindi: अब यहां पर मान लो तंग कर रहा है।
says: Suppose a planet in that 4th house is troubling the native.

hindi: ये कोई नेगेटिव ग्रह बैठा हुआ है।
says: The troubling planet is a negative (malefic) one sitting in that house.
ambiguity: The planet is not named.
classical_check: Agrees that malefics in the 4th reduce home peace.

hindi: तो ये नदी छह नंबर राशि लिखी है ना।
says: In his example chart, the 4th house carries sign number 6 (Virgo), and he ties this house with the river or water remedy.
cells_derived_method: A Virgo 4th house means lagna Gemini (6-4+1=3). A malefic there gives restlessness at home.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in the 4th in Virgo (lagna Gemini) would give a cold, strained home atmosphere; the river offering is the remedy he proposes.
Derived: Mars in the 4th in Virgo (lagna Gemini) would give heat and quarrels at home.

ambiguity: 'छह नंबर राशि' could be sign 6 (Virgo) or house 6; he is writing on the board. 'नदी' may be a caption slip. Taken as Virgo in the 4th.

hindi: चार बियर फेंकने हैं नदी में।
says: The remedy he gives: throw four bottles of beer into a river. The number four matches the 4th house in his example. A tradition claim; he later jokes about it.
cells_derived_method: Number of items matches the house number. For another house he would presumably change the count, but he does not say.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for a negative planet in the 4th in Gemini the same four-bottle offering to flowing water would be used.
Derived: if the same logic were applied to the 10th house, ten items would be offered, but this is not said by him.

ambiguity: Whether four is tied to the 4th house or chosen arbitrarily is not stated. Pollution aside, he later admits it sounds absurd.
classical_check: Silent; liquor offerings to water exist only in folk remedies.

hindi: इस बंदे का काम हो जाएगा।
says: He promises that doing this will solve the person's problem, the work will get done.

hindi: यहां से संबंधित घर संबंधित मान सम्मान चीजों का
says: The offering helps the related house and its matters, including honour and standing.
cells_derived_method: none; the matters of the house are the 4th: home, mother, status.
ambiguity: Sentence trails off; 'मान सम्मान' (honour) is the topic named.

hindi: अब नदी में बीियर फेंकना क्या सिर पैर है बताओ ऐसेसे उपाय होते हैं
says: He admits throwing beer in a river sounds senseless, but says such odd remedies do exist and work.

gist: Apologetic banter repeating 'beer' with the audience.
Jokes that you may drink beer too, it is okay.

hindi: एक आध पीने के लिए रख लें पर उपाय के लिए चार बीियर फेंक के आए
says: He permits keeping one or two bottles to drink, but for the remedy itself four bottles must be thrown away in the river.

gist: Apologises to anyone offended; said he did not mean to upset.
Repeats 'throw the beer' with a confused remark about a small amount and sin.
Repeats that the drinking bottles are kept aside and the remedy ones thrown separately.

hindi: हां आपसे करवाया हुआ करवाया ये उपाय है
says: He says this beer-in-river remedy is one he has actually had people do; he presents it as tried and not hypothetical.
ambiguity: Caption wording is rough.

gist: Says the heaps of remedies lists will be taken in another class.
A brief 'okay' to close the previous topic.
Audience asks why Jupiter is exalted in sign number four (caption garbled as 'मूछ').
Agrees to take one small last question standing there and finish.
Praises the question as a very good one before answering.

hindi: यह जो बृहस्पति है देखो नौ नंबर यहां काम कर रहा है आपका स्वाधिष्ठान पे
says: Jupiter in sign number nine (Sagittarius, its own sign) works at the Swadhisthana chakra, the lower sacral centre of the body.
cells_derived_method: The sign is fixed; the house tells which area of life the sacral, creation-level Jupiter energy fuels: 5th children, 2nd family, 7th partner.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Sagittarius in the 5th; creative and procreative energy is wise and generous, favouring children and teaching.
Derived: Jupiter in Sagittarius in the 9th; the lower drive is guided by dharma and teachers.

ambiguity: 'नौ नंबर' may be sign 9 or house 9; he uses sign numbers in this series, so Sagittarius is taken. Which chakra is mapped to which sign is his own scheme.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts map signs to body parts (Sagittarius = thighs), not to chakras.

hindi: यह कुंडली कुंडलिनी का अंतिम छोर है।
says: This place (the sacral region) is the lowest end of the kundalini, where the energy first sits.
cells_derived_method: none; defines the base of the kundalini scale he uses for Jupiter's signs.
ambiguity: Caption says 'कुंडली' but he means 'कुंडलिनी'; 'अंतिम छोर' read as the lowest end.
classical_check: Silent; kundalini is a yoga idea, not part of Jyotish texts.

hindi: जब कुंडलिनी का यह अंतिम छोर कुंडलिनी यहां नाच रही है बाय डिफॉल्ट इसका काम है रोटी खाना सेक्स करना मल मूत्र करना
says: When kundalini sits at this lowest end, its default functions are only eating, sex and excretion, the basic body drives.
cells_derived_method: none; defines the base level of energy.

hindi: अपने जैसे बच्चे पैदा किए सो गए काम खत्म
says: At this base level a person only breeds children like himself, sleeps, and his life's work is finished; nothing higher is attempted.
cells_derived_method: none; description of the base level.

hindi: इसके ऊपर कई लोगों की खोपड़ी पूरे जन्म में नहीं चलती
says: Many people never get their mind working above this base level in their whole life; they stay stuck at the basic drives.

hindi: तो जब यह बृहस्पति यहां से क्लाइंब करके ऊपर आ जाता है तो आप यह मान के चलें
says: When Jupiter climbs up from this base level to a higher centre, take it that the person has moved to a higher level of life; the next lines explain what this means.
ambiguity: Whether 'climb' means Jupiter moving to a higher sign by transit or the person's energy rising is not stated.

gist: Dismisses the usual advice not to waste semen and similar do-nots as useless talk.

hindi: पर ये वो कुंडलिनी की बात की जाती है एक्चुअली कि आपका कुंडलिनी जो है नीचे से संतुष्ट होने के बाद बृहस्पति सर्वोत्तम फल देगा
says: What the semen advice really means is kundalini: once the kundalini is satisfied at the lower level, Jupiter gives its best results.
cells_derived_method: none; condition for Jupiter giving full results.
ambiguity: 'संतुष्ट' (satisfied) could mean fulfilled or settled, not suppressed.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own interpretation.

hindi: अगर आपका ज्ञान आपने चीज बनाई
says: He starts a test of how far knowledge has risen: whether the person has made things, which the next lines list.
cells_derived_method: none; lead into the list of creations.
ambiguity: Fragment, the 'if' clause is not finished.

hindi: क्या चीज बनाई बच्चे बनाए
says: The first creation at the base level is children; making children is the lowest form of creating.
classical_check: Agrees that children are Jupiter's karaka.

hindi: यहां से शरीर बच्चे बनाता है यह
says: The body makes children from this lower region.
cells_derived_method: none; location of the procreation drive.
ambiguity: Sentence continues into the next chunk with 'natural'.

hindi: यह नेचुरल है हम भी ऐसे पैदा हुए
says: Making children is natural; every person was born that way, so it is not an achievement beyond the base level.
cells_derived_method: none; remark on the base level.

hindi: फिर आपने क्या किया थोड़ा ऊपर आ गए यहां पर मेज कुर्सी टेबल बनानी शुरू कर दी
says: The next stage: the energy moves a little higher and the person starts making practical objects like tables and chairs; creation of useful things.
cells_derived_method: none; second stage of the kundalini climb.
ambiguity: The body location pointed to is a gesture; not in the caption.

hindi: फिर आपने सुंदरता की चीजें बनानी शुरू करी
says: The third stage: the person starts making things of beauty, art and aesthetics.
cells_derived_method: none; third stage of the climb.
classical_check: Silent; beauty is Venus's field classically.

hindi: फिर संसार की चीजें अब मैनिफेस्ट कर रहे हैं कुंडलिनी ऊपर ही तो चढ़ रही है
says: Finally the person manifests worldly things at large; all of this is the kundalini climbing step by step.
cells_derived_method: none; final stage of the climb.

hindi: इसलिए बृहस्पति यहां उच्च का है
says: For this reason Jupiter is exalted at this level, which is the sign he points to as the fourth sign, Cancer.
cells_derived_method: Exaltation is by sign. House changes the area: Jupiter exalted in the 1st makes the person wise and expansive; in the 5th it gives intelligence and children; in the 10th it gives status.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Jupiter in the 1st in Cancer, a Cancer lagna; strong body, caring wisdom and good fortune.
Derived: exalted Jupiter in Cancer in the 5th (Pisces lagna); sharp intelligence, good children and strong advisory ability.

ambiguity: 'यहां' is a gesture; read as sign four (Cancer), consistent with the audience question.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is exalted in Cancer.

hindi: जब पांच नंबर राशि में आता है तो भी रॉकेट है बृहस्पति सूर्य के घर में
says: When Jupiter is in sign number five (Leo, the Sun's house) it is also excellent, like a rocket; Jupiter does very well in the Sun's own sign.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in Leo is strong whichever house it falls in; house gives the area: 1st fame and wisdom, 5th children and intellect, 9th fortune.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Leo in the 1st (Leo lagna); a strong, confident, wise personality.
Derived: Jupiter in Leo in the 9th; good fortune, respected teachers, a dharmic career.

classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter in Leo is good (friend's sign) but not exalted; his 'rocket' is stronger than classical wording.

hindi: इसलिए चार नंबर उच्च क्योंकि पानी बनाता है सब कुछ आपका
says: Sign four is Jupiter's exaltation because water creates everything for you; Cancer, the water sign, is where Jupiter's making and giving is highest.
classical_check: Silent on this reason; the exaltation itself agrees.

hindi: जब चिज्जियां बननी शुरू होती है ना उम्र बढ़ने के साथ तो आपके शरीर का पानी यूज़ हो रहा है।
says: As you make things with age, the water in your body is being used up in creating them.

hindi: इसलिए लोगों को चीजें बनने के बाद शरीर में बीमारी आती है।
says: Hence after people have built things and acquired possessions, illness comes into the body as the body's water is depleted. A tradition view, not a medical statement.

hindi: इसलिए डिटचमेंट कही जाती है।
says: This is why detachment is recommended in traditional teaching.
classical_check: Agrees that detachment (vairagya) is a core spiritual teaching.

hindi: अगर डिटच हो गए हो तो शरीर पे नहीं आएगा।
says: If you are detached from what you made, the illness will not come on the body.
cells_derived_method: none; general claim, health not diagnosed.

hindi: चीज भी बनी है भाड़ में जाए।
says: Even if a thing has been made, let it go to hell; do not worry about it. This is the attitude of detachment he urges.

hindi: बन गई बन गई बीती बात।
says: What is made is made and in the past; do not cling to completed things.

hindi: आप जुड़ जाते हैं।
says: The trouble is that people attach themselves to the things they have made.
cells_derived_method: none; attachment is the cause named.
classical_check: Agrees with the general idea of attachment as the root of suffering.

hindi: शरीर में रोग आते हैं।
says: Because of attachment, diseases arrive in the body. A tradition claim, no diagnosis.

hindi: और रोगों से लड़ने की क्षमता जल तत्व के पास है जो हमारा चंद्रमा है।
says: The body's power to fight disease belongs to the water element, which is the Moon; so a strong Moon is the body's defence.
cells_derived_method: none; Moon karaka claim. Moon's sign and house would show how strong the defence is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in the 6th gives recovery strength, power to fight illness and enemies.
Derived: Moon debilitated in the 8th, a weak water element, shows reduced resistance and hidden anxieties.

classical_check: Partly agrees: the Moon is the classical karaka of body fluids and vitality.
